// src/api/client.ts
var GRAPH_HOST = "https://graph.instagram.com";
var RATE_LIMIT_CODES = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([4, 17, 32, 613, 80007]);
var InstagramApiError = class extends Error {
  constructor(message, status, code, subcode, fbtraceId) {
    super(message);
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
    this.subcode = subcode;
    this.fbtraceId = fbtraceId;
    this.name = "InstagramApiError";
  }
  status;
  code;
  subcode;
  fbtraceId;
  static {
    __name(this, "InstagramApiError");
  }
  /** True when the platform is telling us to back off. */
  get isRateLimit() {
    return this.status === 429 || this.code !== void 0 && RATE_LIMIT_CODES.has(this.code);
  }
};
var InstagramClient = class {
  constructor(accessToken, version2, igUserId = "me") {
    this.accessToken = accessToken;
    this.version = version2;
    this.igUserId = igUserId;
  }
  accessToken;
  version;
  igUserId;
  static {
    __name(this, "InstagramClient");
  }
  base(path) {
    return `${GRAPH_HOST}/${this.version}${path.startsWith("/") ? path : `/${path}`}`;
  }
  /** GET with query params; access_token appended automatically. */
  async get(path, params = {}) {
    const url = new URL(this.base(path));
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(k, v);
    url.searchParams.set("access_token", this.accessToken);
    const res = await fetch(url.toString(), { method: "GET" });
    return this.parse(res);
  }
  /** POST JSON body; access_token as a query param (Graph convention). */
  async post(path, body) {
    const url = new URL(this.base(path));
    url.searchParams.set("access_token", this.accessToken);
    const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    return this.parse(res);
  }
  async parse(res) {
    const text = await res.text();
    let json2 = void 0;
    try {
      json2 = text ? JSON.parse(text) : void 0;
    } catch {
    }
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = json2?.error;
      throw new InstagramApiError(
        err?.message ?? `HTTP ${res.status}`,
        res.status,
        err?.code,
        err?.error_subcode,
        err?.fbtrace_id
      );
    }
    return json2;
  }
  // ---- messaging (Send API) ----
  /** Send a plain text DM to a user by IGSID. */
  sendText(recipientIgsid, text) {
    return this.post(`/${this.igUserId}/messages`, {
      recipient: { id: recipientIgsid },
      message: { text }
    });
  }
  /** Send a text DM with quick-reply chips (rendered after the thread is accepted). */
  sendQuickReplies(recipientIgsid, text, quickReplies) {
    return this.post(`/${this.igUserId}/messages`, {
      recipient: { id: recipientIgsid },
      message: { text, quick_replies: quickReplies }
    });
  }
  /** Send a button-template message with postback buttons (survives the Requests folder). */
  sendButtonTemplate(recipient, text, buttons) {
    return this.post(`/${this.igUserId}/messages`, {
      recipient: recipient.commentId ? { comment_id: recipient.commentId } : { id: recipient.igsid },
      message: {
        attachment: {
          type: "template",
          payload: { template_type: "button", text, buttons }
        }
      }
    });
  }
  /**
   * Open a chat with a fresh commenter via a private reply to their comment. This is the only
   * sanctioned way to DM a new commenter — valid up to 7 days after the comment, once per comment.
   * The opening message uses a button template so it survives the Requests folder (Section: Step 1).
   */
  privateReplyWithButtons(commentId, text, buttons) {
    return this.sendButtonTemplate({ commentId }, text, buttons);
  }
  /**
   * Private-reply to a comment with a plain text message — the whole funnel in one send, used
   * when a campaign delivers the reward directly instead of gating it behind a button tap.
   * Same 7-day / once-per-comment window as privateReplyWithButtons.
   */
  privateReplyText(commentId, text) {
    return this.post(`/${this.igUserId}/messages`, {
      recipient: { comment_id: commentId },
      message: { text }
    });
  }
  // ---- public comment actions ----
  /** Post a public reply under a comment (text only; publishes asynchronously). */
  replyToComment(commentId, message) {
    return this.post(`/${commentId}/replies`, { message });
  }
  // NOTE: there is deliberately no likeComment() here. Instagram's API cannot like a comment.
  // Its comment operations are limited to: read (GET /{media-id}/comments), reply
  // (POST /{comment-id}/replies), delete (DELETE /{comment-id}), hide/unhide
  // (POST /{comment-id}), and enable/disable on media (POST /{media-id}). There is no /likes
  // edge. An earlier version posted to /{comment-id}/likes, which simply errored on every
  // triggering comment.
  // ---- reads ----
  /** Read comments on a media object. Only called for media attached to an active campaign. */
  async getComments(mediaId, limit = 100) {
    const res = await this.get(`/${mediaId}/comments`, {
      fields: "id,text,timestamp,username,from{id,username}",
      limit: String(limit)
    });
    return res.data ?? [];
  }
  /** Read recent conversations + their messages (how inbound taps/replies arrive without webhooks). */
  async getConversations(limit = 20) {
    const res = await this.get(`/${this.igUserId}/conversations`, {
      platform: "instagram",
      fields: "id,messages.limit(10){id,from,to,message,created_time}",
      limit: String(limit)
    });
    return res.data ?? [];
  }
  /**
   * The connected account's profile. Requests only widely-supported fields so OAuth connect never
   * fails on an account where an optional field (e.g. followers_count) isn't returnable; the
   * follower count is fetched separately, on demand, by getFollowersCount.
   */
  getMe() {
    return this.get(`/me`, {
      fields: "user_id,username,account_type,profile_picture_url"
    });
  }
  /** The connected account's media (for the builder media picker + preview). */
  async getMedia(limit = 25) {
    const res = await this.get(`/me/media`, {
      fields: "id,caption,media_type,media_url,thumbnail_url,permalink,like_count,comments_count",
      limit: String(limit)
    });
    return res.data ?? [];
  }
  /**
   * Weak follower-count heuristic for verify_follow_count mode (Section: Step 3). The API cannot
   * verify a specific user's follow; this only reads the account's own follower total.
   */
  async getFollowersCount() {
    const me = await this.get(`/me`, { fields: "followers_count" });
    return me.followers_count;
  }
};
async function refreshLongLivedToken(version2, accessToken) {
  const url = new URL(`${GRAPH_HOST}/refresh_access_token`);
  url.searchParams.set("grant_type", "ig_refresh_token");
  url.searchParams.set("access_token", accessToken);
  const res = await fetch(url.toString());
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new InstagramApiError(`token refresh failed: ${text}`, res.status);
  return JSON.parse(text);
}
__name(refreshLongLivedToken, "refreshLongLivedToken");

// src/queue/queue.ts
var sleep = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)), "sleep");
var SendQueue = class {
  static {
    __name(this, "SendQueue");
  }
  lastSendAt = 0;
  minIntervalMs;
  maxRetries;
  baseBackoffMs;
  constructor(opts = {}) {
    this.minIntervalMs = opts.minIntervalMs ?? 1200;
    this.maxRetries = opts.maxRetries ?? 3;
    this.baseBackoffMs = opts.baseBackoffMs ?? 1e3;
  }
  /**
   * Run a send with pacing + backoff. Throws if it still fails after retries, or on any
   * non-rate-limit error (so the caller can decide whether to leave state unchanged).
   */
  async run(fn) {
    const since = Date.now() - this.lastSendAt;
    if (since < this.minIntervalMs) await sleep(this.minIntervalMs - since);
    let attempt = 0;
    for (; ; ) {
      try {
        const result = await fn();
        this.lastSendAt = Date.now();
        return result;
      } catch (e) {
        const isRate = isRateLimitError(e);
        if (!isRate || attempt >= this.maxRetries) {
          this.lastSendAt = Date.now();
          throw e;
        }
        const backoff = this.baseBackoffMs * 2 ** attempt;
        console.warn(`[chatmany] rate-limited, backing off ${backoff}ms (attempt ${attempt + 1})`);
        await sleep(backoff);
        attempt++;
      }
    }
  }
};
function isRateLimitError(e) {
  return typeof e === "object" && e !== null && e.isRateLimit === true;
}
__name(isRateLimitError, "isRateLimitError");

// src/engine/match.ts
function escapeRegex(s) {
  return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
}
__name(escapeRegex, "escapeRegex");
function matchesKeyword(text, keyword) {
  const kw = keyword.trim();
  if (!kw) return false;
  if (kw === "*") return true;
  const re = new RegExp(`(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}_])${escapeRegex(kw)}(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}_])`, "iu");
  return re.test(text);
}
__name(matchesKeyword, "matchesKeyword");
function matchesAnyKeyword(text, keywords) {
  return keywords.some((k) => matchesKeyword(text, k));
}
__name(matchesAnyKeyword, "matchesAnyKeyword");
function hasExcludedWord(text, exclude) {
  if (!exclude || exclude.length === 0) return false;
  return exclude.some((w) => matchesKeyword(text, w));
}
__name(hasExcludedWord, "hasExcludedWord");
function commentTriggers(text, keywords, exclude) {
  return matchesAnyKeyword(text, keywords) && !hasExcludedWord(text, exclude);
}
__name(commentTriggers, "commentTriggers");
var EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
function extractEmail(text) {
  if (!text) return null;
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  if (EMAIL_RE.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
  const m = trimmed.match(/[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+/);
  return m ? m[0] : null;
}
__name(extractEmail, "extractEmail");

function afterTap(campaign) {
  if (campaign.check_follow) return "AWAITING_FOLLOW";
  if (campaign.ask_email) return "AWAITING_EMAIL";
  return "DELIVER";
}
__name(afterTap, "afterTap");
function afterFollow(campaign) {
  if (campaign.ask_email) return "AWAITING_EMAIL";
  return "DELIVER";
}
__name(afterFollow, "afterFollow");
function expectedTitleForState(state, campaign) {
  switch (state) {
    case "AWAITING_TAP":
      return null;
    // any inbound message counts as the tap
    case "AWAITING_FOLLOW":
      return campaign.copy.follow_button ?? "\u2705 I followed";
    default:
      return null;
  }
}
__name(expectedTitleForState, "expectedTitleForState");

function followRetriesExhausted(retries) {
  return retries >= CAPPED_FOLLOW_RETRIES;
}
__name(followRetriesExhausted, "followRetriesExhausted");
function titleMatches(incoming, expected) {
  if (!incoming) return false;
  return incoming.trim().toLowerCase() === expected.trim().toLowerCase();
}

// src/config.ts
var ConfigError = class extends Error {
  static {
    __name(this, "ConfigError");
  }
};
function isNonEmptyString(v) {
  return typeof v === "string" && v.trim().length > 0;
}
__name(isNonEmptyString, "isNonEmptyString");
function validateCampaign(input, index = 0) {
  const where = `campaigns[${index}]`;
  if (typeof input !== "object" || input === null) {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where} must be an object`);
  }
  const c = input;
  if (!isNonEmptyString(c.campaign_id)) {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where}.campaign_id is required`);
  }
  if (c.platform !== void 0 && c.platform !== "instagram" && c.platform !== "tiktok") {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where}.platform must be "instagram" or "tiktok"`);
  }
  const platform2 = c.platform === "tiktok" ? "tiktok" : "instagram";
  if (!isNonEmptyString(c.media_id)) {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where}.media_id is required`);
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(c.keywords) || c.keywords.length === 0 || !c.keywords.every(isNonEmptyString)) {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where}.keywords must be a non-empty array of strings`);
  }
  if (c.exclude !== void 0 && (!Array.isArray(c.exclude) || !c.exclude.every(isNonEmptyString))) {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where}.exclude must be an array of strings`);
  }
  const reward = c.reward;
  if (!reward || !["link", "code", "text"].includes(reward.type) || !isNonEmptyString(reward.value)) {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where}.reward must be { type: link|code|text, value: string }`);
  }
  const copy = c.copy;
  if (!copy || !isNonEmptyString(copy.opening) || !isNonEmptyString(copy.delivery)) {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where}.copy.opening and copy.delivery are required`);
  }
  if (c.deliver_in_opening !== void 0 && typeof c.deliver_in_opening !== "boolean") {
    throw new ConfigError(`${where}.deliver_in_opening must be a boolean`);
  }
  if (c.deliver_in_opening && (c.check_follow || c.ask_email)) {
    throw new ConfigError(
      `${where}.deliver_in_opening cannot be combined with check_follow or ask_email \u2014 both need the tap flow`
    );
  }
  if (c.public_reply !== void 0) {
    const pr = c.public_reply;
    if (typeof pr.enabled !== "boolean") {
      throw new ConfigError(`${where}.public_reply.enabled must be a boolean`);
    }
    if (pr.enabled && (!Array.isArray(pr.texts) || pr.texts.length === 0 || !pr.texts.every(isNonEmptyString))) {
      throw new ConfigError(`${where}.public_reply.texts must be a non-empty array when enabled`);
    }
  }
  return {
    campaign_id: c.campaign_id,
    platform: platform2,
    name: typeof c.name === "string" ? c.name : void 0,
    media_id: c.media_id,
    keywords: c.keywords,
    exclude: c.exclude ?? [],
    public_reply: c.public_reply,
    like_comment: Boolean(c.like_comment),
    check_follow: Boolean(c.check_follow),
    verify_follow_count: Boolean(c.verify_follow_count),
    ask_email: Boolean(c.ask_email),
    deliver_in_opening: Boolean(c.deliver_in_opening),
    reward: { type: reward.type, value: reward.value },
    copy
  };
}
__name(validateCampaign, "validateCampaign");
function validateConfig(input) {
  if (typeof input !== "object" || input === null) {
    throw new ConfigError("config must be an object");
  }
  const cfg = input;
  if (!Array.isArray(cfg.campaigns) || cfg.campaigns.length === 0) {
    throw new ConfigError("config.campaigns must be a non-empty array");
  }
  const campaigns = cfg.campaigns.map((c, i) => validateCampaign(c, i));
  const ids = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const c of campaigns) {
    if (ids.has(c.campaign_id)) throw new ConfigError(`duplicate campaign_id: ${c.campaign_id}`);
    ids.add(c.campaign_id);
  }
  const mode = cfg.mode === "webhook" ? "webhook" : "polling";
  const interval = typeof cfg.poll_interval_seconds === "number" && cfg.poll_interval_seconds > 0 ? cfg.poll_interval_seconds : 90;
  return { mode, poll_interval_seconds: interval, campaigns };
}
__name(validateConfig, "validateConfig");

// src/db.ts
function now() {
  return Math.floor(Date.now() / 1e3);
}
__name(now, "now");
async function getActiveCampaigns(db, platform2 = "instagram") {
  const rows = await db.prepare("SELECT config_json FROM campaigns WHERE active = 1 AND archived_at IS NULL AND platform = ?").bind(platform2).all();
  const out = [];
  for (const r of rows.results ?? []) {
    try {
      out.push(validateCampaign(JSON.parse(r.config_json)));
    } catch {
    }
  }
  return out;
}
__name(getActiveCampaigns, "getActiveCampaigns");
async function getCampaign(db, campaignId) {
  const row = await db.prepare("SELECT config_json FROM campaigns WHERE campaign_id = ?").bind(campaignId).first();
  if (!row) return null;
  try {
    return validateCampaign(JSON.parse(row.config_json));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
__name(getCampaign, "getCampaign");
async function getAllCampaigns(db, opts = {}) {
  const where = opts.archived ? "archived_at IS NOT NULL" : "archived_at IS NULL";
  const rows = await db.prepare(`SELECT config_json, active, updated_at, archived_at FROM campaigns WHERE ${where} ORDER BY updated_at DESC`).all();
  const out = [];
  for (const r of rows.results ?? []) {
    try {
      out.push({
        campaign: validateCampaign(JSON.parse(r.config_json)),
        active: r.active === 1,
        archived: r.archived_at != null,
        updated_at: r.updated_at
      });
    } catch {
    }
  }
  return out;
}
__name(getAllCampaigns, "getAllCampaigns");

  await db.prepare(
    `INSERT INTO campaigns (campaign_id, platform, media_id, config_json, active, updated_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(campaign_id) DO UPDATE SET
         platform = excluded.platform,
         media_id = excluded.media_id,
         config_json = excluded.config_json,
         active = excluded.active,
         updated_at = excluded.updated_at`
  ).bind(campaign.campaign_id, campaign.platform ?? "instagram", campaign.media_id, JSON.stringify(campaign), active ? 1 : 0, now()).run();

async function processedCommentIds(db, commentIds) {
  const found = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const CHUNK = 100;
  for (let i = 0; i < commentIds.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const chunk = commentIds.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    if (chunk.length === 0) continue;
    const placeholders = chunk.map(() => "?").join(",");
    const res = await db.prepare(`SELECT comment_id FROM processed_comments WHERE comment_id IN (${placeholders})`).bind(...chunk).all();
    for (const row of res.results ?? []) found.add(row.comment_id);
  }
  return found;
}
__name(processedCommentIds, "processedCommentIds");

    )
  );
}

async function updateConversation(db, igsid, campaignId, patch) {
  const sets = [];
  const binds = [];
  if (patch.state !== void 0) {
    sets.push("state = ?");
    binds.push(patch.state);
  }
  if (patch.conversation_id !== void 0) {
    sets.push("conversation_id = ?");
    binds.push(patch.conversation_id);
  }
  if (patch.email !== void 0) {
    sets.push("email = ?");
    binds.push(patch.email);
  }
  if (patch.followed !== void 0) {
    sets.push("followed = ?");
    binds.push(patch.followed);
  }
  if (patch.follow_retries !== void 0) {
    sets.push("follow_retries = ?");
    binds.push(patch.follow_retries);
  }
  if (sets.length === 0) return;
  sets.push("updated_at = ?");
  binds.push(now(), igsid, campaignId);
  await db.prepare(`UPDATE conversations SET ${sets.join(", ")} WHERE igsid = ? AND campaign_id = ?`).bind(...binds).run();
}
__name(updateConversation, "updateConversation");

async function eventCountsByType(db, campaignId, sinceTs) {
  const base = {
    comment_matched: 0,
    opening_sent: 0,
    button_clicked: 0,
    follow_confirmed: 0,
    email_captured: 0,
    delivered: 0
  };
  const rows = campaignId ? await db.prepare(
    `SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE campaign_id = ? AND created_at >= ? GROUP BY type`
  ).bind(campaignId, sinceTs).all() : await db.prepare(`SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE created_at >= ? GROUP BY type`).bind(sinceTs).all();
  for (const r of rows.results ?? []) {
    if (r.type in base) base[r.type] = r.n;
  }
  return base;
}
__name(eventCountsByType, "eventCountsByType");
async function listConversations(db, campaignId, limit = 500) {
  const rows = campaignId ? await db.prepare("SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?").bind(campaignId, limit).all() : await db.prepare("SELECT * FROM conversations ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?").bind(limit).all();
  return rows.results ?? [];
}
__name(listConversations, "listConversations");
async function getAuth(db) {
  return await db.prepare("SELECT * FROM auth WHERE id = 1").first();
}
__name(getAuth, "getAuth");
async function saveAuth(db, fields) {
  await db.prepare(
    `INSERT INTO auth (id, access_token, ig_user_id, username, account_type, profile_picture_url, expires_at, refreshed_at)
       VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
         access_token = excluded.access_token,
         ig_user_id = COALESCE(excluded.ig_user_id, auth.ig_user_id),
         username = COALESCE(excluded.username, auth.username),
         account_type = COALESCE(excluded.account_type, auth.account_type),
         profile_picture_url = COALESCE(excluded.profile_picture_url, auth.profile_picture_url),
         expires_at = excluded.expires_at,
         refreshed_at = excluded.refreshed_at`
  ).bind(
    fields.access_token,
    fields.ig_user_id ?? null,
    fields.username ?? null,
    fields.account_type ?? null,
    fields.profile_picture_url ?? null,
    fields.expires_at,
    now()
  ).run();
}
__name(saveAuth, "saveAuth");
async function clearAuth(db) {
  await db.prepare("DELETE FROM auth WHERE id = 1").run();
}
__name(clearAuth, "clearAuth");

       VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
         access_token = excluded.access_token,
         refresh_token = excluded.refresh_token,
         business_id = excluded.business_id,
         username = COALESCE(excluded.username, tiktok_auth.username),
         display_name = COALESCE(excluded.display_name, tiktok_auth.display_name),
         profile_image = COALESCE(excluded.profile_image, tiktok_auth.profile_image),
         scope = COALESCE(excluded.scope, tiktok_auth.scope),
         expires_at = excluded.expires_at,
         refresh_expires_at = excluded.refresh_expires_at,
         refreshed_at = excluded.refreshed_at`
  ).bind(
    fields.access_token,
    fields.refresh_token,
    fields.business_id,
    fields.username ?? null,
    fields.display_name ?? null,
    fields.profile_image ?? null,
    fields.scope ?? null,

__name(clearTikTokAuth, "clearTikTokAuth");
async function kvGet(db, key) {
  const row = await db.prepare("SELECT value FROM kv WHERE key = ?").bind(key).first();
  return row?.value ?? null;
}
__name(kvGet, "kvGet");
async function kvSet(db, key, value) {
  await db.prepare(
    `INSERT INTO kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, updated_at = excluded.updated_at`
  ).bind(key, value, now()).run();
}
__name(kvSet, "kvSet");
async function claimPollSlot(db, intervalSeconds) {
  const ts = now();
  await db.prepare(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('last_poll_ts', '0', ?)`).bind(ts).run();
  const res = await db.prepare(`UPDATE kv SET value = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE key = 'last_poll_ts' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER) <= ?`).bind(String(ts), ts, ts - intervalSeconds).run();
  return (res.meta?.changes ?? 0) > 0;
}
__name(claimPollSlot, "claimPollSlot");

// src/engine/engine.ts
var OPENING_PAYLOAD = "OPENING_TAP";
var FOLLOW_PAYLOAD = "FOLLOW_CONFIRM";
function pickRotating(texts, seed) {
  let h = 0;
  for (const ch of seed) h = h * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0) >>> 0;
  return texts[h % texts.length];
}
__name(pickRotating, "pickRotating");
var Engine = class {
  constructor(db, client, queue) {
    this.db = db;
    this.client = client;
    this.queue = queue;
  }
  db;
  client;
  queue;
  static {
    __name(this, "Engine");
  }
  // ---- comments ----
  /**
   * Handle a new comment: trigger match → public actions → opening DM. Idempotent per comment.
   * `activeCampaigns` may be passed by the poller (already fetched) to avoid a DB read per comment;
   * the webhook path omits it and we fetch on demand.
   */
  async handleComment(evt, activeCampaigns) {
    if (this.rateLimited) return;
    if (await isCommentProcessed(this.db, evt.comment_id)) return;
    if (!evt.igsid) return;
    const all = activeCampaigns ?? await getActiveCampaigns(this.db);
    const campaigns = all.filter((c) => c.media_id === evt.media_id);
    let matchedCampaignId = "-";
    let pendingRetry = false;
    for (const campaign of campaigns) {
      if (!commentTriggers(evt.text, campaign.keywords, campaign.exclude)) continue;
      matchedCampaignId = campaign.campaign_id;
      const existing = await getConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id);
      if (existing) continue;
      this.lastRefusal = null;
      const sent = await this.sendOpening(campaign, evt);
      if (!sent) {
        if (!this.rateLimited && isPermanentRefusal(this.lastRefusal)) {
          const r = this.lastRefusal;
          matchedCampaignId = `refused:${campaign.campaign_id}:${r.code ?? ""}/${r.subcode ?? ""}`;
          console.warn(`[chatmany] permanent refusal for comment ${evt.comment_id}; not retrying: ${r.message}`);
          await this.sendRefusalFallback(campaign, evt);
          continue;
        }
        pendingRetry = true;
        continue;
      }
      await this.runPublicActions(campaign, evt);
    }
    if (!pendingRetry) await markCommentProcessed(this.db, evt.comment_id, evt.igsid, matchedCampaignId);
  }
  /**
   * Instagram refuses a private reply to most non-followers (code 100 / subcode 2534001). Those
   * people can still be reached if THEY message us first, so leave a public reply under their
   * comment asking for a DM. Guarded by the comment_actions ledger: once per comment, ever.
   */
  async sendRefusalFallback(campaign, evt) {
    const text = REFUSAL_FALLBACK_TEXT.replaceAll("{keyword}", campaign.keywords[0] ?? "");
    if (!text) return;
    if (!await claimCommentAction(this.db, evt.comment_id, "refusal_fallback")) return;
    await this.trySend(() => this.client.replyToComment(evt.comment_id, text), "refusal_fallback");
  }
  /**
   * Someone DMed us a campaign keyword (usually after the fallback reply above): answer with the
   * reward. This is the Send API, not a private reply, so it works regardless of follow status.
   * One send per person per campaign; the conversation row is the dedupe.
   */
  async handleInboundKeyword(evt) {
    if (this.rateLimited || !evt.igsid || !evt.text) return;
    const all = await getActiveCampaigns(this.db);
    const matching = all.filter((c) => c.deliver_in_opening && commentTriggers(evt.text, c.keywords, c.exclude));
    if (matching.length === 0) return;
    for (const c of matching) {
      if (await getConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, c.campaign_id)) return;
    }
    const campaign = matching[0];
    const sent = await this.trySend(
      () => this.client.sendText(evt.igsid, renderDelivery(campaign)),
      "inbound_keyword",
      `inbound:${campaign.campaign_id}:${evt.igsid}`
    );
    if (!sent) return;
    await createConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, evt.username ?? null, "DONE");
    await logEvents(this.db, [
      { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "comment_matched", igsid: evt.igsid },
      { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "opening_sent", igsid: evt.igsid },
      { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "delivered", igsid: evt.igsid }
    ]);
  }
  async runPublicActions(campaign, evt) {
    if (campaign.public_reply?.enabled && campaign.public_reply.texts.length > 0) {
      if (await claimCommentAction(this.db, evt.comment_id, "public_reply")) {
        const text = pickRotating(campaign.public_reply.texts, evt.comment_id);
        await this.trySend(() => this.client.replyToComment(evt.comment_id, text), "public_reply");
      }
    }
  }
  /**
   * Open the chat via a private reply to the comment, using a postback button (Step 1).
   * Returns true if the opening was sent and the funnel entry recorded; false on a send failure
   * (so the caller leaves the comment unprocessed for a retry on the next poll).
   */
  async sendOpening(campaign, evt) {
    if (campaign.deliver_in_opening) {
      const text = renderDelivery(campaign);
      const ok2 = await this.trySend(
        () => this.client.privateReplyText(evt.comment_id, text),
        "opening_direct",
        `opening:${campaign.campaign_id}:${evt.comment_id}`
      );
      if (!ok2) return false;
      await createConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, evt.username ?? null, "DONE");
      await logEvents(this.db, [
        { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "comment_matched", igsid: evt.igsid },
        { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "opening_sent", igsid: evt.igsid },
        { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "delivered", igsid: evt.igsid }
      ]);
      return true;
    }
    const button = {
      type: "postback",
      title: campaign.copy.opening_button ?? "Continue",
      payload: OPENING_PAYLOAD
    };
    const ok = await this.trySend(
      () => this.client.privateReplyWithButtons(evt.comment_id, campaign.copy.opening, [button]),
      "opening",
      `opening:${campaign.campaign_id}:${evt.comment_id}`
    );
    if (!ok) return false;
    await createConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, evt.username ?? null, "AWAITING_TAP");
    await logEvents(this.db, [
      { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "comment_matched", igsid: evt.igsid },
      { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "opening_sent", igsid: evt.igsid }
    ]);
    return true;
  }
  // ---- messages ----
  /**
   * Handle an inbound message: advance any of this person's open conversations. In polling mode
   * the hidden payload is often unavailable, so taps are resolved by matching the message text to
   * the expected button title for the current state (and, for AWAITING_TAP, any inbound message
   * counts — the opening postback posts no visible text; webhook mode also delivers the payload).
   */
  async handleMessage(evt) {
    await this.handleInboundKeyword(evt);
    const open = await getOpenConversations(this.db, evt.igsid);
    for (const convo of open) {
      if (evt.timestamp <= convo.updated_at) continue;
      const campaign = await getCampaign(this.db, convo.campaign_id);
      if (!campaign) continue;
      switch (convo.state) {
        case "AWAITING_TAP":
          await this.onTap(campaign, evt);
          break;
        case "AWAITING_FOLLOW":
          await this.onFollow(campaign, evt, convo.follow_retries);
          break;
        case "AWAITING_EMAIL":
          await this.onEmail(campaign, evt);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    }
  }
  async onTap(campaign, evt) {
    await this.enterState(campaign, evt.igsid, afterTap(campaign), { entryEvent: "button_clicked" });
  }
  async onFollow(campaign, evt, retries) {
    const expected = expectedTitleForState("AWAITING_FOLLOW", campaign) ?? "";
    const isConfirm = evt.payload === FOLLOW_PAYLOAD || titleMatches(evt.text, expected);
    if (!isConfirm) return;
    if (campaign.verify_follow_count && !followRetriesExhausted(retries)) {
      const looksFollowed = await this.followerCountGrew(campaign, evt.igsid);
      if (!looksFollowed) {
        await this.resendFollowGate(campaign, evt.igsid, retries);
        return;
      }
    }
    await this.enterState(campaign, evt.igsid, afterFollow(campaign), {
      entryEvent: "follow_confirmed",
      patch: { followed: 1 }
    });
  }
  async onEmail(campaign, evt) {
    const email = evt.email ?? extractEmail(evt.text);
    if (!email) {
      await this.resendEmailAsk(campaign, evt.igsid);
      return;
    }
    await this.enterState(campaign, evt.igsid, "DELIVER", { entryEvent: "email_captured", patch: { email } });
  }
  async resendEmailAsk(campaign, igsid) {
    const ok = await this.trySend(
      () => this.client.sendQuickReplies(
        igsid,
        campaign.copy.email_ask ?? "Tap your email or reply with it \u{1F447}",
        [{ content_type: "user_email" }]
      ),
      "email_ask_resend"
    );
    if (ok) {
      await updateConversation(this.db, igsid, campaign.campaign_id, { state: "AWAITING_EMAIL" });
    }
  }
  /**
   * Enter a target state: perform the outbound send first, then — only if it succeeded — persist
   * the new state together with any field patch and log the entry event, in that single write. A
   * failed send changes nothing (no state, no updated_at bump, no event), so the triggering message
   * re-fires on the next poll and the entry event is never double-counted. DELIVER collapses to DONE.
   */
  async enterState(campaign, igsid, target, opts = {}) {
    const commit = /* @__PURE__ */ __name(async (restingState, extra) => {
      await updateConversation(this.db, igsid, campaign.campaign_id, { state: restingState, ...opts.patch });
      if (opts.entryEvent) await logEvent(this.db, campaign.campaign_id, opts.entryEvent, igsid);
      if (extra) await logEvent(this.db, campaign.campaign_id, extra, igsid);
    }, "commit");
    switch (target) {
      case "AWAITING_FOLLOW": {
        const ok = await this.trySend(
          () => this.client.sendQuickReplies(igsid, campaign.copy.follow_gate ?? "Follow us first \u{1F64C}", [
            { content_type: "text", title: campaign.copy.follow_button ?? "\u2705 I followed", payload: FOLLOW_PAYLOAD }
          ]),
          "follow_gate",
          `follow_gate:${campaign.campaign_id}:${igsid}`
        );
        if (!ok) return;
        if (campaign.verify_follow_count) await this.captureFollowerBaseline(campaign, igsid);
        await commit("AWAITING_FOLLOW");
        break;
      }
      case "AWAITING_EMAIL": {
        const ok = await this.trySend(
          () => this.client.sendQuickReplies(
            igsid,
            campaign.copy.email_ask ?? "Tap your email or reply with it \u{1F447}",
            [{ content_type: "user_email" }]
          ),
          "email_ask",
          `email_ask:${campaign.campaign_id}:${igsid}`
        );
        if (!ok) return;
        await commit("AWAITING_EMAIL");
        break;
      }
      case "DELIVER": {
        const text = renderDelivery(campaign);
        const ok = await this.trySend(
          () => this.client.sendText(igsid, text),
          "delivery",
          `delivery:${campaign.campaign_id}:${igsid}`
        );
        if (!ok) return;
        await commit("DONE", "delivered");
        break;
      }
      default:
        await commit(target);
    }
  }
  async resendFollowGate(campaign, igsid, retries) {
    const ok = await this.trySend(
      () => this.client.sendQuickReplies(igsid, campaign.copy.follow_gate ?? "Follow us first \u{1F64C}", [
        { content_type: "text", title: campaign.copy.follow_button ?? "\u2705 I followed", payload: FOLLOW_PAYLOAD }
      ]),
      "follow_gate_resend"
    );
    if (ok) {
      await updateConversation(this.db, igsid, campaign.campaign_id, { follow_retries: retries + 1 });
    }
  }
  // ---- verify_follow_count helpers (weak heuristic) ----
  baselineKey(campaign, igsid) {
    return `follow_baseline:${campaign.campaign_id}:${igsid}`;
  }
  async captureFollowerBaseline(campaign, igsid) {
    try {
      const count3 = await this.client.getFollowersCount();
      if (count3 !== void 0) await kvSet(this.db, this.baselineKey(campaign, igsid), String(count3));
    } catch {
    }
  }
  async followerCountGrew(campaign, igsid) {
    const baselineRaw = await kvGet(this.db, this.baselineKey(campaign, igsid));
    if (baselineRaw === null) return true;
    try {
      const current = await this.client.getFollowersCount();
      if (current === void 0) return true;
      return current > Number(baselineRaw);
    } catch {
      return true;
    }
  }
  // ---- send helpers ----
  /**
   * Run a send through the queue, at most once per `key`.
   *
   * Sends are claimed before they go out. The outcome of a failed send is not always knowable:
   * a timeout, dropped connection, or 5xx can all arrive *after* Instagram already delivered the
   * message. Treating those as "never happened" and retrying is what shows a person the same DM
   * twice, so instead:
   *
   *   - the platform answered with an error (any HTTP status) → the request reached Instagram and
   *     was rejected, so nothing was delivered: release the claim and report failure so the caller
   *     retries cleanly on the next poll;
   *   - no answer at all (network error, timeout, dropped connection) → we never learned the
   *     outcome and it may well have landed, so keep the claim and report success, advancing the
   *     funnel rather than risking a duplicate;
   *   - claim already held → a previous attempt got far enough to send, so skip and report
   *     success. This is what catches a retry after the Worker died mid-send.
   *
   * The trade is deliberate: at-most-once delivery. A genuinely lost message leaves that person
   * where they were instead of being messaged again.
   */
  async trySend(fn, label, key) {
    const claimKey = key ?? null;
    if (claimKey && !await claimSend(this.db, claimKey)) {
      console.warn(`[chatmany] skipping ${label}: already attempted, may have delivered (${claimKey})`);
      return true;
    }
    this.sendsThisRun = (this.sendsThisRun ?? 0) + 1;
    try {
      await this.queue.run(fn);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      const refused = e instanceof InstagramApiError && !isAmbiguousFailure(e);
      if (refused) {
        this.lastRefusal = e;
        if (e.isRateLimit) this.rateLimited = true;
        if (claimKey) await releaseSend(this.db, claimKey);
        console.warn(`[chatmany] send failed (${label}), will retry: ${msg(e)}`);
        return false;
      }
      console.warn(
        `[chatmany] send outcome unknown (${label}): ${msg(e)} \u2014 treating as delivered so it is not sent twice`
      );
      return claimKey ? true : false;
    }
  }
};
function msg(e) {
  return e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
}
__name(msg, "msg");
function isPermanentRefusal(e) {
  if (!(e instanceof InstagramApiError) || e.isRateLimit) return false;
  if (!(e.status >= 400 && e.status < 500)) return false;
  if (e.subcode === 2534001 || e.code === 10 || e.code === 551) return true;
  return e.code === 100 && /cannot be found|does not exist|not available/i.test(e.message ?? "");
}
__name(isPermanentRefusal, "isPermanentRefusal");
function isAmbiguousFailure(e) {
  if (e.isRateLimit) return false;
  return e.status >= 500 || e.code === 1 || e.code === 2;
}
__name(isAmbiguousFailure, "isAmbiguousFailure");
function renderDelivery(campaign) {
  return campaign.copy.delivery.replaceAll("{reward}", campaign.reward.value);
}
__name(renderDelivery, "renderDelivery");

// src/runtime.ts
async function buildRuntime(env2) {
  const auth = await getAuth(env2.DB);
  if (!auth) {
    console.warn("[chatmany] no Instagram account connected; skipping.");
    return null;
  }
  if (auth.expires_at <= now()) {
    console.warn("[chatmany] access token expired; owner must reconnect. Skipping.");
    return null;
  }
  const igUserId = auth.ig_user_id ?? "me";
  const client = new InstagramClient(auth.access_token, env2.GRAPH_VERSION, igUserId);
  const queue = new SendQueue();
  const engine = new Engine(env2.DB, client, queue);
  return { client, queue, engine, auth, igUserId };
}
__name(buildRuntime, "buildRuntime");
function toUnixSeconds(iso) {
  if (!iso) return now();
  const ms = Date.parse(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(ms) ? now() : Math.floor(ms / 1e3);
}
__name(toUnixSeconds, "toUnixSeconds");

// src/poller/commentPoll.ts
var OPENING_CAP_PER_HOUR = 750;
var HEAD_MAX_PAGES = 5;
var SWEEP_PAGES_PER_RUN = 8;
var MAX_SENDS_PER_RUN = 30;
var INBOX_PAGES_PER_RUN = 6;
var REFUSAL_FALLBACK_TEXT = "ig won't let me dm you first 😭 dm me the word {keyword} and i'll send the link";
var RUN_BUDGET_MS = 8 * 60 * 1e3;
var RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 600;
var PRIVATE_REPLY_WINDOW_SECONDS = 7 * 86400 - 3600;
var COMMENT_FIELDS = "id,text,timestamp,username,from{id,username},replies.limit(50){id,text,timestamp,username,from{id,username}}";
async function fetchCommentPage(rt, mediaId, after) {
  const params = { fields: COMMENT_FIELDS, limit: "100" };
  if (after) params.after = after;
  try {
    return await rt.client.get(`/${mediaId}/comments`, params);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn(`[chatmany] getComments(${mediaId}) failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
    return null;
  }
}
async function handleCommentPage(rt, db, mediaId, campaigns, res, startedAt) {
  const comments = [];
  for (const c of res?.data ?? []) {
    comments.push(c);
    for (const r of c.replies?.data ?? []) comments.push(r);
  }
  let alreadyHandled;
  try {
    alreadyHandled = await processedCommentIds(db, comments.map((c) => c.id));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn(`[chatmany] processedCommentIds failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
    return { fresh: 0, stop: "error", oldest: now() };
  }
  let fresh = 0;
  let oldest = now();
  for (const c of comments) {
    const ts = toUnixSeconds(c.timestamp);
    if (ts < oldest) oldest = ts;
    if (alreadyHandled.has(c.id)) continue;
    const seen = rt.engine.attemptedThisRun ??= /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    if (seen.has(c.id)) continue;
    const igsid = c.from?.id;
    if (!igsid || igsid === rt.client.igUserId) continue;
    if (now() - ts > PRIVATE_REPLY_WINDOW_SECONDS) continue;
    fresh++;
    seen.add(c.id);
    await rt.engine.handleComment({
      kind: "comment",
      comment_id: c.id,
      igsid,
      username: c.from?.username ?? c.username,
      text: c.text ?? "",
      media_id: mediaId,
      timestamp: ts
    }, campaigns);
    if (rt.engine.rateLimited) {
      await kvSet(db, "rate_limited_until", String(now() + RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS));
      console.warn(`[chatmany] Instagram rate limit hit; pausing comment polling for ${RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS}s.`);
      return { fresh, stop: "rate", oldest };
    }
    if ((rt.engine.sendsThisRun ?? 0) >= MAX_SENDS_PER_RUN || Date.now() - startedAt > RUN_BUDGET_MS) return { fresh, stop: "budget", oldest };
  }
  return { fresh, stop: null, oldest };
}
async function pollComments(rt, db) {
  const cooldownUntil = Number(await kvGet(db, "rate_limited_until") ?? 0);
  if (cooldownUntil > now()) {
    console.warn(`[chatmany] Instagram rate-limit cooldown, ${cooldownUntil - now()}s left; skipping comment poll.`);
    return;
  }
  const campaigns = await getActiveCampaigns(db);
  if (campaigns.length === 0) return;
  const sinceHour = now() - 3600;
  const openingsThisHour = await countEventsGlobal(db, "opening_sent", sinceHour);
  if (openingsThisHour >= OPENING_CAP_PER_HOUR) {
    console.warn(`[chatmany] opening cap reached (${openingsThisHour}/hr); deferring comment poll.`);
    return;
  }
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  const mediaIds = [...new Set(campaigns.map((c) => c.media_id))].sort();
  for (const mediaId of mediaIds) {
    let after;
    for (let page = 0; page < HEAD_MAX_PAGES; page++) {
      const res = await fetchCommentPage(rt, mediaId, after);
      if (!res) break;
      const out = await handleCommentPage(rt, db, mediaId, campaigns, res, startedAt);
      if (out.stop === "rate" || out.stop === "budget") return;
      after = res.paging?.cursors?.after;
      if (out.stop || out.fresh === 0 || !res.paging?.next || !after || now() - out.oldest > PRIVATE_REPLY_WINDOW_SECONDS) break;
    }
  }
  let idx = Number(await kvGet(db, "sweep_media_idx") ?? 0);
  if (!(idx >= 0 && idx < mediaIds.length)) idx = 0;
  const mediaId = mediaIds[idx];
  const cursorKey = `sweep_cursor:${mediaId}`;
  let cursor = await kvGet(db, cursorKey) || void 0;
  for (let page = 0; page < SWEEP_PAGES_PER_RUN; page++) {
    const res = await fetchCommentPage(rt, mediaId, cursor);
    if (!res) break;
    const out = await handleCommentPage(rt, db, mediaId, campaigns, res, startedAt);
    if (out.stop) {
      await kvSet(db, cursorKey, cursor ?? "");
      return;
    }
    const next = res.paging?.cursors?.after;
    const exhausted = !res.paging?.next || !next || now() - out.oldest > PRIVATE_REPLY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    if (exhausted) {
      await kvSet(db, cursorKey, "");
      await kvSet(db, "sweep_media_idx", String((idx + 1) % mediaIds.length));
      return;
    }
    cursor = next;
  }
  await kvSet(db, cursorKey, cursor ?? "");
}
__name(pollComments, "pollComments");

// src/poller/messagePoll.ts
var CURSOR_KEY = "last_msg_poll_ts";
var OVERLAP_SECONDS = 120;
async function pollMessages(rt, db) {
  const cursorRaw = await kvGet(db, CURSOR_KEY);
  const cursor = cursorRaw ? Number(cursorRaw) : 0;
  const floor = cursor > 0 ? cursor - OVERLAP_SECONDS : 0;
  const conversations = [];
  try {
    let after;
    for (let page = 0; page < INBOX_PAGES_PER_RUN; page++) {
      const params = {
        platform: "instagram",
        fields: "id,updated_time,messages.limit(10){id,from,to,message,created_time}",
        limit: "50"
      };
      if (after) params.after = after;
      const res = await rt.client.get(`/${rt.igUserId}/conversations`, params);
      const data = res?.data ?? [];
      for (const c of data) conversations.push(c);
      after = res?.paging?.cursors?.after;
      const oldest = data.length ? toUnixSeconds(data[data.length - 1].updated_time) : 0;
      if (!data.length || !res?.paging?.next || !after || oldest < floor) break;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn(`[chatmany] getConversations failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
    return;
  }
  let maxTs = cursor;
  let stopped = false;
  for (const convo of conversations) {
    if (stopped) break;
    for (const m of convo.messages?.data ?? []) {
      if (rt.engine.rateLimited || (rt.engine.sendsThisRun ?? 0) >= MAX_SENDS_PER_RUN) {
        stopped = true;
        break;
      }
      const fromId = m.from?.id;
      if (!fromId || fromId === rt.igUserId) continue;
      const ts = toUnixSeconds(m.created_time);
      if (ts < floor) continue;
      if (ts > maxTs) maxTs = ts;
      const evt = {
        kind: "message",
        igsid: fromId,
        text: m.message,
        timestamp: ts
        // Polling does not expose the hidden quick-reply payload; the engine resolves taps by
        // matching text to the expected button title for the conversation's state.
      };
      await rt.engine.handleMessage(evt);
    }
  }
  if (stopped) {
    if (rt.engine.rateLimited) {
      await kvSet(db, "rate_limited_until", String(now() + RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS));
      console.warn(`[chatmany] Instagram rate limit hit on inbound DMs; pausing ${RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS}s.`);
    }
    console.warn("[chatmany] inbound pass stopped early; leaving the cursor for the next run.");
    return;
  }
  await kvSet(db, CURSOR_KEY, String(Math.max(maxTs, now() - OVERLAP_SECONDS)));
}
__name(pollMessages, "pollMessages");

// src/auth/refresh.ts
var DAY = 86400;
var REFRESH_WHEN_WITHIN = 30 * DAY;
var MIN_TOKEN_AGE = DAY + 3600;
async function refreshTokenIfDue(env2) {
  const auth = await getAuth(env2.DB);
  if (!auth) return { status: "no_auth" };
  const ts = now();
  if (auth.expires_at <= ts) {
    console.warn(
      `[chatmany] access token EXPIRED at ${new Date(auth.expires_at * 1e3).toISOString()}; owner must reconnect Instagram.`
    );
    return { status: "expired" };
  }
  if (auth.expires_at - ts > REFRESH_WHEN_WITHIN) {
    return { status: "skipped", expiresAt: auth.expires_at };
  }
  const lastSet = auth.refreshed_at ?? auth.expires_at - 60 * DAY;
  if (ts - lastSet < MIN_TOKEN_AGE) {
    return { status: "too_new", expiresAt: auth.expires_at };
  }
  try {
    const { access_token, expires_in } = await refreshLongLivedToken(env2.GRAPH_VERSION, auth.access_token);
    const expiresAt = now() + expires_in;
    await saveAuth(env2.DB, { access_token, expires_at: expiresAt });
    console.log(`[chatmany] token refreshed; new expiry ${new Date(expiresAt * 1e3).toISOString()}`);
    return { status: "refreshed", expiresAt };
  } catch (e) {
    const detail = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    console.warn(`[chatmany] token refresh FAILED (${detail}); expiry ${new Date(auth.expires_at * 1e3).toISOString()}`);
    return { status: "error", detail, expiresAt: auth.expires_at };
  }
}
__name(refreshTokenIfDue, "refreshTokenIfDue");

// src/auth/oauth.ts
var SCOPES = [
  "instagram_business_basic",
  "instagram_business_manage_messages",
  "instagram_business_manage_comments"
];
function buildAuthorizeUrl(appId, redirectUri, state) {
  const url = new URL("https://www.instagram.com/oauth/authorize");
  url.searchParams.set("client_id", appId);
  url.searchParams.set("redirect_uri", redirectUri);
  url.searchParams.set("response_type", "code");
  url.searchParams.set("scope", SCOPES.join(","));
  url.searchParams.set("state", state);
  return url.toString();
}
__name(buildAuthorizeUrl, "buildAuthorizeUrl");
async function exchangeCodeForShortLivedToken(appId, appSecret, redirectUri, code) {
  const body = new URLSearchParams({
    client_id: appId,
    client_secret: appSecret,
    grant_type: "authorization_code",
    redirect_uri: redirectUri,
    code
  });
  const res = await fetch("https://api.instagram.com/oauth/access_token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new InstagramApiError(`code exchange failed: ${text}`, res.status);
  const json2 = JSON.parse(text);
  return { accessToken: json2.access_token, userId: String(json2.user_id), permissions: json2.permissions };
}
__name(exchangeCodeForShortLivedToken, "exchangeCodeForShortLivedToken");
async function exchangeForLongLivedToken(version2, appSecret, shortLivedToken) {
  const url = new URL("https://graph.instagram.com/access_token");
  url.searchParams.set("grant_type", "ig_exchange_token");
  url.searchParams.set("client_secret", appSecret);
  url.searchParams.set("access_token", shortLivedToken);
  const res = await fetch(url.toString());
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new InstagramApiError(`long-lived exchange failed: ${text}`, res.status);
  const json2 = JSON.parse(text);
  return { accessToken: json2.access_token, expiresIn: json2.expires_in };
}
__name(exchangeForLongLivedToken, "exchangeForLongLivedToken");

// src/routes/http.ts
function json(body, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body, null, 2), {
    status,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" }
  });
}
__name(json, "json");
function html(body, status = 200) {
  return new Response(`<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><body style="font-family:system-ui;max-width:40rem;margin:3rem auto;padding:0 1rem">${body}</body>`, {
    status,
    headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }
  });
}
__name(html, "html");
function redirect(location, status = 302) {
  return new Response(null, { status, headers: { location } });
}
__name(redirect, "redirect");
function isOwner(req, url, env2) {
  if (!env2.OWNER_TOKEN) return false;
  const header = req.headers.get("authorization") ?? "";
  const bearer = header.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ") ? header.slice(7).trim() : "";
  const supplied = bearer || url.searchParams.get("token") || "";
  return timingSafeEqual(supplied, env2.OWNER_TOKEN);
}
__name(isOwner, "isOwner");
function timingSafeEqual(a, b) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let mismatch = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) mismatch |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return mismatch === 0;
}
__name(timingSafeEqual, "timingSafeEqual");

// src/routes/auth.ts
var STATE_KEY = "oauth_state";
function randomState() {
  return crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "");
}
__name(randomState, "randomState");
async function handleAuthorize(env2) {
  if (!env2.APP_ID || !env2.APP_SECRET) {
    return json({ error: "APP_ID/APP_SECRET not configured" }, 500);
  }
  const state = randomState();
  await kvSet(env2.DB, STATE_KEY, state);
  return redirect(buildAuthorizeUrl(env2.APP_ID, env2.REDIRECT_URI, state));
}
__name(handleAuthorize, "handleAuthorize");
async function handleCallback(env2, url) {
  const error3 = url.searchParams.get("error");
  if (error3) {
    return html(`<h1>Connection cancelled</h1><p>${escapeHtml(error3)}</p>`, 400);
  }
  const code = url.searchParams.get("code");
  const state = url.searchParams.get("state");
  if (!code) return html("<h1>Missing authorization code</h1>", 400);
  const expected = await kvGet(env2.DB, STATE_KEY);
  if (!expected || state !== expected) return html("<h1>Invalid state (possible CSRF)</h1>", 400);
  try {
    const short = await exchangeCodeForShortLivedToken(env2.APP_ID, env2.APP_SECRET, env2.REDIRECT_URI, code);
    console.log(`[chatmany] OAuth granted permissions: ${JSON.stringify(short.permissions ?? "none reported")}`);
    const long = await exchangeForLongLivedToken(env2.GRAPH_VERSION, env2.APP_SECRET, short.accessToken);
    const client = new InstagramClient(long.accessToken, env2.GRAPH_VERSION, "me");
    const me = await client.getMe();
    const accountType = (me.account_type ?? "").toUpperCase();
    if (accountType === "PERSONAL") {
      return html(
        `<h1>Personal accounts aren't supported</h1>
         <p>chatmany needs an Instagram <b>Professional</b> (Creator or Business) account.</p>
         <p>In the Instagram app: <b>Settings \u2192 Account type and tools \u2192 Switch to professional account</b>, then reconnect.</p>`,
        400
      );
    }
    await saveAuth(env2.DB, {
      access_token: long.accessToken,
      expires_at: now() + long.expiresIn,
      ig_user_id: me.user_id ?? short.userId,
      username: me.username ?? null,
      account_type: me.account_type ?? null,
      profile_picture_url: me.profile_picture_url ?? null
    });
    return html(
      `<h1>Connected \u2705</h1>
       <p>@${escapeHtml(me.username ?? "your account")} is now connected to chatmany.</p>
       <p>Token valid ~60 days; it auto-refreshes. You can close this tab.</p>`
    );
  } catch (e) {
    return html(`<h1>Connection failed</h1><pre>${escapeHtml(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))}</pre>`, 500);
  }
}
__name(handleCallback, "handleCallback");
async function handleStatus(env2) {
  const auth = await getAuth(env2.DB);
  if (!auth) return json({ connected: false });
  return json({
    connected: true,
    username: auth.username,
    account_type: auth.account_type,
    profile_picture_url: auth.profile_picture_url,
    ig_user_id: auth.ig_user_id,
    expires_at: auth.expires_at,
    expires_in_days: Math.max(0, Math.round((auth.expires_at - now()) / 86400))
  });
}
__name(handleStatus, "handleStatus");
async function handleDisconnect(env2) {
  await clearAuth(env2.DB);
  return json({ disconnected: true });
}
__name(handleDisconnect, "handleDisconnect");
function escapeHtml(s) {
  return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" })[c]);
}
__name(escapeHtml, "escapeHtml");

// src/routes/config.ts
async function handleConfigImport(env2, req) {
  let payload;
  try {
    payload = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return json({ error: "invalid JSON body" }, 400);
  }
  let cfg;
  try {
    cfg = validateConfig(payload);
  } catch (e) {
    return json({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }, 400);
  }
  for (const campaign of cfg.campaigns) {
    await upsertCampaign(env2.DB, campaign, true);
  }
  return json({ imported: cfg.campaigns.length, campaign_ids: cfg.campaigns.map((c) => c.campaign_id) });
}
__name(handleConfigImport, "handleConfigImport");

}
