// src/routes/webhook.ts
function handleWebhookVerify(env2, url) {
  const mode = url.searchParams.get("hub.mode");
  const token = url.searchParams.get("hub.verify_token");
  const challenge = url.searchParams.get("hub.challenge");
  if (mode === "subscribe" && token && token === env2.WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN && challenge) {
    return new Response(challenge, { status: 200, headers: { "content-type": "text/plain" } });
  }
  return new Response("forbidden", { status: 403 });
}
__name(handleWebhookVerify, "handleWebhookVerify");
async function handleWebhookEvent(env2, req) {
  const raw = await req.text();
  const sig = req.headers.get("x-hub-signature-256");
  if (!await verifySignature(env2.APP_SECRET, raw, sig)) {
    return new Response("invalid signature", { status: 401 });
  }
  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return json({ error: "invalid JSON" }, 400);
  }
  const rt = await buildRuntime(env2);
  if (!rt) return json({ ok: true, note: "no account connected" });
  for (const entry of body.entry ?? []) {
    for (const change of entry.changes ?? []) {
      if (change.field !== "comments") continue;
      const v = change.value;
      const igsid = v.from?.id;
      const mediaId = v.media?.id;
      if (!igsid || !mediaId || !v.id) continue;
      const evt = {
        kind: "comment",
        comment_id: v.id,
        igsid,
        username: v.from?.username,
        text: v.text ?? "",
        media_id: mediaId,
        timestamp: toUnixSeconds(v.timestamp)
      };
      await rt.engine.handleComment(evt);
    }
    for (const m of entry.messaging ?? []) {
      const igsid = m.sender?.id;
      if (!igsid || igsid === rt.igUserId) continue;
      const payload = m.postback?.payload ?? m.message?.quick_reply?.payload;
      const evt = {
        kind: "message",
        igsid,
        text: m.message?.text ?? m.postback?.title,
        payload,
        timestamp: m.timestamp ? Math.floor(m.timestamp / 1e3) : toUnixSeconds(void 0)
      };
      await rt.engine.handleMessage(evt);
    }
  }
  return json({ ok: true });
}
__name(handleWebhookEvent, "handleWebhookEvent");
async function verifySignature(appSecret, raw, header) {
  if (!header || !header.startsWith("sha256=") || !appSecret) return false;
  const expected = header.slice("sha256=".length);
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    new TextEncoder().encode(appSecret),
    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"]
  );
  const mac = await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, new TextEncoder().encode(raw));
  const actual = [...new Uint8Array(mac)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  if (actual.length !== expected.length) return false;
  let mismatch = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < actual.length; i++) mismatch |= actual.charCodeAt(i) ^ expected.charCodeAt(i);
  return mismatch === 0;
}
__name(verifySignature, "verifySignature");

// src/api/tiktok.ts
var API_BASE = "https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3";
var TT_CODE = {
  OK: 0,
  NO_PERMISSION: 40001,
  PARAM_ERROR: 40002,
  NOT_FOUND: 40007,
  DM_BLOCKED: 40064,
  // outside the 48h window or a cold conversation
  RATE_LIMITED: 40100,
  BAD_TOKEN: 40105,
  SYSTEM_ERROR: 51065
};
var TikTokApiError = class extends Error {
  constructor(message, status, code, requestId) {
    super(message);
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
    this.requestId = requestId;
    this.name = "TikTokApiError";
  }
  status;
  code;
  requestId;
  static {
    __name(this, "TikTokApiError");
  }
  get isRateLimit() {
    return this.status === 429 || this.code === TT_CODE.RATE_LIMITED;
  }
  get isBadToken() {
    return this.status === 401 || this.code === TT_CODE.BAD_TOKEN;
  }
};
var COMMENT_REPLY_MAX = 150;
var QA_TITLE_MAX = 40;
var QA_BUTTON_MAX = 20;
var TikTokClient = class {
  constructor(accessToken, businessId) {
    this.accessToken = accessToken;
    this.businessId = businessId;
  }
  accessToken;
  businessId;
  static {
    __name(this, "TikTokClient");
  }
  // ---- transport ----
  async get(path, params) {
    const url = new URL(`${API_BASE}${path}`);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(k, v);
    const res = await fetch(url.toString(), { method: "GET", headers: { "Access-Token": this.accessToken } });
    return this.parse(res, path);
  }
  async post(path, body) {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Access-Token": this.accessToken, "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    return this.parse(res, path);
  }
  async parse(res, path) {
    const text = await res.text();
    let json2;
    try {
      json2 = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      throw new TikTokApiError(`TikTok ${path}: HTTP ${res.status} (unparseable body: ${text.slice(0, 200)})`, res.status);
    }
    if (!res.ok || json2.code !== TT_CODE.OK) {
      throw new TikTokApiError(
        `TikTok ${path}: code ${json2.code} ${json2.message ?? ""} (request_id ${json2.request_id ?? "?"})`.trim(),
        res.status,
        json2.code,
        json2.request_id
      );
    }
    return json2.data ?? {};
  }
  // ---- Accounts API: account + videos ----
  /** GET /business/get/ — username, display name, avatar of the connected account. */
  getProfile() {
    return this.get("/business/get/", {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      fields: JSON.stringify(["username", "display_name", "profile_image"])
    });
  }
  /** GET /business/video/list/ — the account's own posts, newest first (max_count ≤ 20 per page). */
  async listVideos(maxCount = 20) {
    const data = await this.get("/business/video/list/", {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      fields: JSON.stringify(["item_id", "media_type", "caption", "thumbnail_url", "share_url", "create_time", "comments", "likes", "video_views"]),
      max_count: String(Math.min(20, Math.max(1, maxCount)))
    });
    return data.videos ?? [];
  }
  // ---- Accounts API: comments ----
  /** GET /business/comment/list/ — top-level comments on an owned video, newest first (max_count ≤ 30). */
  async listComments(videoId, maxCount = 30, cursor) {
    const params = {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      video_id: videoId,
      status: "ALL",
      sort_field: "create_time",
      sort_type: "desc",
      max_count: String(Math.min(30, Math.max(1, maxCount)))
    };
    if (cursor !== void 0) params.cursor = String(cursor);
    const data = await this.get("/business/comment/list/", params);
    return { comments: data.comments ?? [], hasMore: Boolean(data.has_more), cursor: data.cursor };
  }
  /** GET /business/comment/list/ with comment_ids — fetch specific comments (≤30) by id, e.g. after a comment.update webhook. */
  async getComments(videoId, commentIds) {
    if (commentIds.length === 0) return [];
    const data = await this.get("/business/comment/list/", {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      video_id: videoId,
      comment_ids: JSON.stringify(commentIds.slice(0, 30)),
      status: "ALL"
    });
    return data.comments ?? [];
  }
  /** POST /business/comment/reply/create/ — public reply under a comment (≤150 chars). */
  replyToComment(videoId, commentId, text) {
    return this.post("/business/comment/reply/create/", {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      video_id: videoId,
      comment_id: commentId,
      text: clip(text, COMMENT_REPLY_MAX)
    });
  }
  // ---- Business Messaging API ----
  /** POST /business/message/send/ — plain text into an existing conversation (≤6000 chars). */
  sendText(conversationId, body) {
    return this.post("/business/message/send/", {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      recipient_type: "CONVERSATION",
      recipient: conversationId,
      message_type: "TEXT",
      text: { body }
    });
  }
  /**
   * POST /business/message/send/ — a Q&A button card: a question (≤40 chars) with 1–3 REPLY buttons
   * (≤20 chars each). Tapping a button sends its label back as the person's message, and the
   * inbound webhook carries our button `id` in reply_source_payload.reply_source_unique_id.
   */
  sendQaButtons(conversationId, title2, buttons) {
    return this.post("/business/message/send/", {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      recipient_type: "CONVERSATION",
      recipient: conversationId,
      message_type: "TEMPLATE",
      template: {
        type: "QA_BUTTON_CARD",
        title: clip(title2, QA_TITLE_MAX),
        buttons: buttons.slice(0, 3).map((b) => ({ type: "REPLY", title: clip(b.title, QA_BUTTON_MAX), id: clip(b.id, 40) }))
      }
    });
  }
  /** GET /business/message/conversation/list/ — STRANGER (they wrote, we never replied) or SINGLE (we replied). Past 90 days, ≤100. */
  async listConversations(type, limit = 100) {
    const data = await this.get("/business/message/conversation/list/", {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      conversation_type: type,
      limit: String(Math.min(100, Math.max(1, limit)))
    });
    return data.conversations ?? [];
  }
  /** GET /business/message/content/list/ — the 20 most recent messages of a conversation + participants. */
  async listMessages(conversationId) {
    const data = await this.get("/business/message/content/list/", {
      business_id: this.businessId,
      conversation_id: conversationId
      // URLSearchParams encodes '+' as %2B, which the docs require
    });
    return { messages: data.messages ?? [], participants: data.participants ?? [] };
  }
};
function clip(s, max) {
  const chars = [...s];
  return chars.length <= max ? s : chars.slice(0, max - 1).join("") + "\u2026";
}
__name(clip, "clip");
var TIKTOK_SCOPES = [
  "user.info.basic",
  "user.info.username",
  "user.account.type",
  "video.list",
  "comment.list",
  "comment.list.manage",
  "message.list.read",
  "message.list.send",
  "message.list.manage"
];
function buildTikTokAuthorizeUrl(appId, redirectUri, state, scopes = TIKTOK_SCOPES) {
  const url = new URL("https://www.tiktok.com/v2/auth/authorize");
  url.searchParams.set("client_key", appId);
  url.searchParams.set("response_type", "code");
  url.searchParams.set("scope", scopes.join(","));
  url.searchParams.set("redirect_uri", redirectUri);
  url.searchParams.set("state", state);
  return url.toString();
}
__name(buildTikTokAuthorizeUrl, "buildTikTokAuthorizeUrl");
async function tokenCall(path, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json2;
  try {
    json2 = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    throw new TikTokApiError(`TikTok ${path}: HTTP ${res.status} (unparseable body)`, res.status);
  }
  if (!res.ok || json2.code !== TT_CODE.OK || !json2.data?.access_token) {
    throw new TikTokApiError(`TikTok ${path}: code ${json2.code} ${json2.message ?? ""}`.trim(), res.status, json2.code, json2.request_id);
  }
  return json2.data;
}
__name(tokenCall, "tokenCall");
function exchangeTikTokCode(appId, appSecret, redirectUri, code) {
  return tokenCall("/tt_user/oauth2/token/", {
    client_id: appId,
    client_secret: appSecret,
    grant_type: "authorization_code",
    auth_code: code,
    redirect_uri: redirectUri
  });
}
__name(exchangeTikTokCode, "exchangeTikTokCode");
function refreshTikTokToken(appId, appSecret, refreshToken) {
  return tokenCall("/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/", {
    client_id: appId,
    client_secret: appSecret,
    grant_type: "refresh_token",
    refresh_token: refreshToken
  });
}
__name(refreshTikTokToken, "refreshTikTokToken");
async function appCall(method, path, params) {
  let res;
  if (method === "GET") {
    const url = new URL(`${API_BASE}${path}`);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
    res = await fetch(url.toString(), { headers: { accept: "application/json" } });
  } else {
    res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(params)
    });
  }
  const text = await res.text();
  let json2;
  try {
    json2 = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    throw new TikTokApiError(`TikTok ${path}: HTTP ${res.status} (unparseable body)`, res.status);
  }
  if (!res.ok || json2.code !== TT_CODE.OK) {
    throw new TikTokApiError(`TikTok ${path}: code ${json2.code} ${json2.message ?? ""}`.trim(), res.status, json2.code, json2.request_id);
  }
  return json2.data ?? {};
}
__name(appCall, "appCall");
function subscribeTikTokWebhook(appId, appSecret, eventType, callbackUrl, itemList) {
  const body = { app_id: appId, secret: appSecret, event_type: eventType, callback_url: callbackUrl };
  if (eventType === "COMMENT" && itemList && itemList.length > 0) body.item_list = itemList;
  return appCall("POST", "/business/webhook/update/", body);
}
__name(subscribeTikTokWebhook, "subscribeTikTokWebhook");
function getTikTokWebhook(appId, appSecret, eventType) {
  return appCall("GET", "/business/webhook/list/", { app_id: appId, secret: appSecret, event_type: eventType });
}
__name(getTikTokWebhook, "getTikTokWebhook");

// src/engine/tiktokEngine.ts
var TT_FOLLOW_PAYLOAD = "FOLLOW_CONFIRM";
var DEFAULT_NUDGE = `DM me "{keyword}" and I'll send it over \u{1F4E9}`;
var DEFAULT_FOLLOW_GATE = "Follow us first \u{1F64C}";
var DEFAULT_FOLLOW_BUTTON = "\u2705 I followed";
var DEFAULT_EMAIL_ASK = "Reply with your email and I'll send it there too \u{1F447}";
var FOLLOW_CARD_TITLE = "Tap once you've followed";
function pickRotating2(texts, seed) {
  let h = 0;
  for (const ch of seed) h = h * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0) >>> 0;
  return texts[h % texts.length];
}
__name(pickRotating2, "pickRotating");
function renderNudge(campaign, seed) {
  const texts = campaign.public_reply?.enabled ? campaign.public_reply.texts : [];
  const base = texts.length > 0 ? pickRotating2(texts, seed) : campaign.copy.opening?.trim() || DEFAULT_NUDGE;
  return base.replaceAll("{keyword}", campaign.keywords[0] ?? "");
}
__name(renderNudge, "renderNudge");
function renderDelivery2(campaign) {
  return campaign.copy.delivery.replaceAll("{reward}", campaign.reward.value);
}
__name(renderDelivery2, "renderDelivery");
var TikTokEngine = class {
  constructor(db, client, queue) {
    this.db = db;
    this.client = client;
    this.queue = queue;
  }
  db;
  client;
  queue;
  static {
    __name(this, "TikTokEngine");
  }
  // ---- comments ----
  /** A new top-level comment on an owned video: keyword match → public nudge → AWAITING_DM. */
  async handleComment(evt, activeCampaigns) {
    if (await isCommentProcessed(this.db, evt.comment_id)) return;
    if (!evt.igsid) return;
    const all = activeCampaigns ?? await getActiveCampaigns(this.db, "tiktok");
    const campaigns = all.filter((c) => c.media_id === evt.media_id);
    let matchedCampaignId = "-";
    let pendingRetry = false;
    for (const campaign of campaigns) {
      if (!commentTriggers(evt.text, campaign.keywords, campaign.exclude)) continue;
      matchedCampaignId = campaign.campaign_id;
      const existing = await getConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id);
      if (existing && existing.state !== "AWAITING_DM") continue;
      const sent = await this.trySend(
        () => this.client.replyToComment(evt.media_id, evt.comment_id, renderNudge(campaign, evt.comment_id)),
        "nudge",
        `nudge:${campaign.campaign_id}:${evt.comment_id}`
      );
      if (!sent) {
        pendingRetry = true;
        continue;
      }
      if (!existing) {
        await createConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, evt.username ?? null, "AWAITING_DM");
        await logEvents(this.db, [
          { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "comment_matched", igsid: evt.igsid },
          { campaignId: campaign.campaign_id, type: "opening_sent", igsid: evt.igsid }
        ]);
      }
    }
    if (!pendingRetry) await markCommentProcessed(this.db, evt.comment_id, evt.igsid, matchedCampaignId);
  }
  // ---- messages ----
  /** An inbound DM from a personal account. Advances every open funnel it applies to. */
  async handleMessage(evt) {
    if (!evt.conversation_id) return;
    const open = await getOpenConversations(this.db, evt.igsid);
    const awaitingDm = open.filter((c) => c.state === "AWAITING_DM");
    const handled = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    for (const convo of open) {
      const campaign = await getCampaign(this.db, convo.campaign_id);
      if (!campaign || campaign.platform !== "tiktok") continue;
      handled.add(campaign.campaign_id);
      if (convo.state === "AWAITING_DM") {
        const keyed = commentTriggers(evt.text ?? "", campaign.keywords, campaign.exclude);
        if (!keyed && awaitingDm.length !== 1) continue;
        await this.onDm(campaign, evt);
        continue;
      }
      if (evt.timestamp <= convo.updated_at) continue;
      switch (convo.state) {
        case "AWAITING_FOLLOW":
          await this.onFollow(campaign, evt, convo.follow_retries);
          break;
        case "AWAITING_EMAIL":
          await this.onEmail(campaign, evt);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    }
    if (!evt.text) return;
    for (const campaign of await getActiveCampaigns(this.db, "tiktok")) {
      if (handled.has(campaign.campaign_id)) continue;
      if (!commentTriggers(evt.text, campaign.keywords, campaign.exclude)) continue;
      const existing = await getConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id);
      if (!existing) {
        await createConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, evt.username ?? null, "AWAITING_DM", evt.conversation_id);
        await this.onDm(campaign, evt);
      } else if (existing.state === "DONE") {
        await this.redeliver(campaign, evt);
      }
    }
  }
  /**
   * Every inbound message that completes a transition is remembered per campaign, so a webhook
   * retry (or a polling re-read) of the same message can never act twice — in particular it must
   * not look like "an already-served person asking again" and trigger a second delivery.
   */
  seenKey(campaign, evt) {
    return `msg:${campaign.campaign_id}:${evt.igsid}:${evt.message_id ?? evt.timestamp}`;
  }
  /** Their DM arrived: record the conversation to answer on, then run the gates or deliver. */
  async onDm(campaign, evt) {
    const target = { igsid: evt.igsid, conversation_id: evt.conversation_id };
    await updateConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, { conversation_id: target.conversation_id });
    let next = afterTap(campaign);
    let extraEvent;
    let patch;
    if (next === "AWAITING_FOLLOW" && evt.is_follower === true) {
      next = afterFollow(campaign);
      extraEvent = "follow_confirmed";
      patch = { followed: 1 };
    }
    const committed = await this.enterState(campaign, target, next, { entryEvent: "button_clicked", extraEvent, patch });
    if (committed) await claimSend(this.db, this.seenKey(campaign, evt));
  }
  async onFollow(campaign, evt, retries) {
    const expected = campaign.copy.follow_button ?? DEFAULT_FOLLOW_BUTTON;
    const isConfirm = evt.payload === TT_FOLLOW_PAYLOAD || titleMatches(evt.text, expected);
    if (!isConfirm) return;
    const target = { igsid: evt.igsid, conversation_id: evt.conversation_id };
    if (evt.is_follower === false && !followRetriesExhausted(retries)) {
      await this.resendFollowGate(campaign, target, retries);
      return;
    }
    await this.enterState(campaign, target, afterFollow(campaign), { entryEvent: "follow_confirmed", patch: { followed: 1 } });
  }
  async onEmail(campaign, evt) {
    const target = { igsid: evt.igsid, conversation_id: evt.conversation_id };
    const email = evt.email ?? extractEmail(evt.text);
    if (!email) {
      const ok = await this.trySend(
        () => this.client.sendText(target.conversation_id, campaign.copy.email_ask ?? DEFAULT_EMAIL_ASK),
        "email_ask_resend"
      );
      if (ok) await updateConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, { state: "AWAITING_EMAIL" });
      return;
    }
    await this.enterState(campaign, target, "DELIVER", { entryEvent: "email_captured", patch: { email } });
  }
  /** Someone already served DMs the keyword again: send the delivery once more, once per message. */
  async redeliver(campaign, evt) {
    const seen = this.seenKey(campaign, evt);
    if (!await claimSend(this.db, seen)) return;
    const outcome = await this.attempt(() => this.client.sendText(evt.conversation_id, renderDelivery2(campaign)), "redelivery", null);
    if (outcome === "refused") {
      await releaseSend(this.db, seen);
      return;
    }
    await updateConversation(this.db, evt.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, { state: "DONE", conversation_id: evt.conversation_id });
    await logEvent(this.db, campaign.campaign_id, "delivered", evt.igsid);
  }
  /**
   * Enter a target state: send first, then — only if the send succeeded — persist the state,
   * the patch and the entry event(s) together. A failed send changes nothing, so the triggering
   * message is handled again on the next delivery/poll. DELIVER collapses to DONE.
   */
  async enterState(campaign, target, next, opts = {}) {
    const commit = /* @__PURE__ */ __name(async (restingState, ...events) => {
      await updateConversation(this.db, target.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, { state: restingState, ...opts.patch });
      for (const e of [opts.entryEvent, opts.extraEvent, ...events]) {
        if (e) await logEvent(this.db, campaign.campaign_id, e, target.igsid);
      }
    }, "commit");
    switch (next) {
      case "AWAITING_FOLLOW": {
        const ok = await this.trySend(
          () => this.sendFollowGate(campaign, target),
          "follow_gate",
          `follow_gate:${campaign.campaign_id}:${target.igsid}`
        );
        if (!ok) return false;
        await commit("AWAITING_FOLLOW");
        break;
      }
      case "AWAITING_EMAIL": {
        const ok = await this.trySend(
          () => this.client.sendText(target.conversation_id, campaign.copy.email_ask ?? DEFAULT_EMAIL_ASK),
          "email_ask",
          `email_ask:${campaign.campaign_id}:${target.igsid}`
        );
        if (!ok) return false;
        await commit("AWAITING_EMAIL");
        break;
      }
      case "DELIVER": {
        const ok = await this.trySend(
          () => this.client.sendText(target.conversation_id, renderDelivery2(campaign)),
          "delivery",
          `delivery:${campaign.campaign_id}:${target.igsid}`
        );
        if (!ok) return false;
        await commit("DONE", "delivered");
        break;
      }
      default:
        await commit(next);
    }
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * The follow gate as a Q&A button card. Card titles are capped at 40 characters, so longer
   * gate copy goes out as a text message first, followed by a short card carrying the button.
   */
  async sendFollowGate(campaign, target) {
    const gate = campaign.copy.follow_gate ?? DEFAULT_FOLLOW_GATE;
    const button = { title: campaign.copy.follow_button ?? DEFAULT_FOLLOW_BUTTON, id: TT_FOLLOW_PAYLOAD };
    if ([...gate].length <= QA_TITLE_MAX) {
      return this.client.sendQaButtons(target.conversation_id, gate, [button]);
    }
    await this.client.sendText(target.conversation_id, gate);
    return this.client.sendQaButtons(target.conversation_id, FOLLOW_CARD_TITLE, [button]);
  }
  async resendFollowGate(campaign, target, retries) {
    const ok = await this.trySend(() => this.sendFollowGate(campaign, target), "follow_gate_resend");
    if (ok) await updateConversation(this.db, target.igsid, campaign.campaign_id, { follow_retries: retries + 1 });
  }
  // ---- send helper (same at-most-once contract as engine.ts) ----
  /**
   * Run a send through the queue, at most once per `key`. A definite refusal (TikTok answered
   * with a non-5xx error code, including rate limiting) releases the claim so the caller retries;
   * an ambiguous outcome (network error, 5xx, TikTok "system error") keeps the claim and reports
   * success, because the message may already be in the person's inbox.
   */
  async trySend(fn, label, key) {
    return await this.attempt(fn, label, key ?? null) !== "refused";
  }
  async attempt(fn, label, claimKey) {
    if (claimKey && !await claimSend(this.db, claimKey)) {
      console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] skipping ${label}: already attempted, may have delivered (${claimKey})`);
      return "skipped";
    }
    try {
      await this.queue.run(fn);
      return "sent";
    } catch (e) {
      const refused = e instanceof TikTokApiError && !isAmbiguousFailure2(e);
      if (refused) {
        if (claimKey) await releaseSend(this.db, claimKey);
        console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] send failed (${label}), will retry: ${msg2(e)}`);
        return "refused";
      }
      console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] send outcome unknown (${label}): ${msg2(e)} \u2014 treating as delivered so it is not sent twice`);
      return claimKey ? "sent" : "refused";
    }
  }
};
function msg2(e) {
  return e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
}
__name(msg2, "msg");
function isAmbiguousFailure2(e) {
  if (e.isRateLimit) return false;
  return e.status >= 500 || e.code === TT_CODE.SYSTEM_ERROR;
}
__name(isAmbiguousFailure2, "isAmbiguousFailure");

// src/auth/tiktokRefresh.ts
var REFRESH_WHEN_WITHIN2 = 2 * 3600;
async function refreshTikTokTokenIfDue(env2, opts = {}) {
  if (!env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID || !env2.TIKTOK_APP_SECRET) return { status: "no_app" };
  const auth = await getTikTokAuth(env2.DB);
  if (!auth) return { status: "no_auth" };
  const ts = now();
  if (auth.refresh_expires_at <= ts) {
    console.warn(
      `[chatmany:tiktok] refresh token EXPIRED at ${new Date(auth.refresh_expires_at * 1e3).toISOString()}; owner must reconnect TikTok.`
    );
    return { status: "expired" };
  }
  if (!opts.force && auth.expires_at - ts > REFRESH_WHEN_WITHIN2) return { status: "skipped", expiresAt: auth.expires_at };
  try {
    const d = await refreshTikTokToken(env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID, env2.TIKTOK_APP_SECRET, auth.refresh_token);
    const expiresAt = ts + d.expires_in;
    await saveTikTokAuth(env2.DB, {
      access_token: d.access_token,
      refresh_token: d.refresh_token || auth.refresh_token,
      business_id: d.open_id || auth.business_id,
      expires_at: expiresAt,
      refresh_expires_at: d.refresh_token_expires_in ? ts + d.refresh_token_expires_in : auth.refresh_expires_at,
      scope: d.scope ?? null
    });
    console.log(`[chatmany:tiktok] token refreshed; new expiry ${new Date(expiresAt * 1e3).toISOString()}`);
    return { status: "refreshed", expiresAt };
  } catch (e) {
    const detail = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] token refresh FAILED (${detail}); expiry ${new Date(auth.expires_at * 1e3).toISOString()}`);
    return { status: "error", detail, expiresAt: auth.expires_at };
  }
}
__name(refreshTikTokTokenIfDue, "refreshTikTokTokenIfDue");

// src/tiktokRuntime.ts
async function buildTikTokRuntime(env2) {
  let auth = await getTikTokAuth(env2.DB);
  if (!auth) return null;
  if (auth.expires_at <= now() + 60) {
    const r = await refreshTikTokTokenIfDue(env2, { force: true });
    if (r.status !== "refreshed") {
      console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] access token unusable (${r.status}${r.detail ? `: ${r.detail}` : ""}); skipping.`);
      return null;
    }
    auth = await getTikTokAuth(env2.DB);
  }
  const client = new TikTokClient(auth.access_token, auth.business_id);
  const queue = new SendQueue({ minIntervalMs: 1500 });
  const engine = new TikTokEngine(env2.DB, client, queue);
  return { client, queue, engine, auth, businessId: auth.business_id };
}
__name(buildTikTokRuntime, "buildTikTokRuntime");

// src/routes/tiktokAuth.ts
var STATE_KEY2 = "tiktok_oauth_state";
function configured(env2) {
  if (!env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID || !env2.TIKTOK_APP_SECRET) return "TIKTOK_APP_ID / TIKTOK_APP_SECRET not configured (wrangler secret put)";
  if (!env2.TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI) return "TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI not configured (wrangler.toml [vars])";
  return null;
}
__name(configured, "configured");
async function handleTikTokAuthorize(env2, url) {
  const problem = configured(env2);
  if (problem) return json({ error: problem }, 500);
  const state = crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "");
  await kvSet(env2.DB, STATE_KEY2, state);
  let target = buildTikTokAuthorizeUrl(env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID, env2.TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI, state, TIKTOK_SCOPES);
  if (url.searchParams.get("force") === "1") target += "&disable_auto_auth=1";
  return redirect(target);
}
__name(handleTikTokAuthorize, "handleTikTokAuthorize");
async function handleTikTokCallback(env2, url) {
  const problem = configured(env2);
  if (problem) return html(`<h1>TikTok not configured</h1><p>${escapeHtml2(problem)}</p>`, 500);
  const error3 = url.searchParams.get("error");
  if (error3) {
    const desc = url.searchParams.get("error_description") ?? "";
    return html(`<h1>Connection cancelled</h1><p>${escapeHtml2(error3)} ${escapeHtml2(desc)}</p>`, 400);
  }
  const code = url.searchParams.get("code");
  const state = url.searchParams.get("state");
  if (!code) {
    return html(
      `<h1>No authorization code</h1>
       <p>TikTok skipped the consent page because this account already authorized the app. Reconnect with a forced consent:</p>
       <p><a href="/auth/tiktok/authorize?force=1">Connect TikTok again</a></p>`,
      400
    );
  }
  const expected = await kvGet(env2.DB, STATE_KEY2);
  if (!expected || state !== expected) return html("<h1>Invalid state (possible CSRF)</h1>", 400);
  try {
    const tok = await exchangeTikTokCode(env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID, env2.TIKTOK_APP_SECRET, env2.TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI, code);
    console.log(`[chatmany:tiktok] OAuth granted scopes: ${tok.scope ?? "none reported"}`);
    const ts = now();
    let profile3 = {};
    try {
      profile3 = await new TikTokClient(tok.access_token, tok.open_id).getProfile();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] profile read failed after connect: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
    }
    await saveTikTokAuth(env2.DB, {
      access_token: tok.access_token,
      refresh_token: tok.refresh_token,
      business_id: tok.open_id,
      expires_at: ts + tok.expires_in,
      refresh_expires_at: ts + tok.refresh_token_expires_in,
      scope: tok.scope ?? null,
      username: profile3.username ?? null,
      display_name: profile3.display_name ?? null,
      profile_image: profile3.profile_image ?? null
    });
    const missing = TIKTOK_SCOPES.filter((s) => !(tok.scope ?? "").split(",").map((x) => x.trim()).includes(s));
    return html(
      `<h1>TikTok connected \u2705</h1>
       <p>@${escapeHtml2(profile3.username ?? tok.open_id)} is now connected to chatmany.</p>
       ${missing.length ? `<p><b>Heads up:</b> these scopes were not granted: ${escapeHtml2(missing.join(", "))}. Comment replies need comment.list.manage; DMs need message.list.send.</p>` : ""}
       <p>The access token is refreshed automatically (valid 1 day; the refresh token lasts 1 year). You can close this tab.</p>`
    );
  } catch (e) {
    return html(`<h1>Connection failed</h1><pre>${escapeHtml2(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))}</pre>`, 500);
  }
}
__name(handleTikTokCallback, "handleTikTokCallback");
async function tikTokStatus(env2) {
  const auth = await getTikTokAuth(env2.DB);
  const ts = now();
  if (!auth) return { connected: false, configured: !configured(env2) };
  return {
    connected: true,
    configured: !configured(env2),
    username: auth.username,
    display_name: auth.display_name,
    profile_image: auth.profile_image,
    business_id: auth.business_id,
    scope: auth.scope,
    expires_at: auth.expires_at,
    refresh_expires_at: auth.refresh_expires_at,
    expires_in_days: Math.max(0, Math.round((auth.refresh_expires_at - ts) / 86400)),
    token_expired: auth.refresh_expires_at <= ts
  };
}
__name(tikTokStatus, "tikTokStatus");
async function handleTikTokStatus(env2) {
  return json(await tikTokStatus(env2));
}
__name(handleTikTokStatus, "handleTikTokStatus");

async function handleTikTokWebhookAdmin(env2, req, url) {
  const problem = configured(env2);
  if (problem) return json({ error: problem }, 500);
  const types = ["COMMENT", "DIRECT_MESSAGE"];
  if (req.method.toUpperCase() === "POST") {
    let body = {};
    try {
      body = await req.json();
    } catch {
    }
    const callbackUrl = body.callback_url || `${url.origin}/webhook/tiktok`;
    const results2 = {};
    for (const t of types) {
      try {
        results2[t] = await subscribeTikTokWebhook(env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID, env2.TIKTOK_APP_SECRET, t, callbackUrl, t === "COMMENT" ? body.item_list : void 0);
      } catch (e) {
        results2[t] = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) };
      }
    }
    return json({ callback_url: callbackUrl, results: results2 });
  }
  const results = {};
  for (const t of types) {
    try {
      results[t] = await getTikTokWebhook(env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID, env2.TIKTOK_APP_SECRET, t);
    } catch (e) {
      results[t] = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) };
    }
  }
  return json({ results });
}
__name(handleTikTokWebhookAdmin, "handleTikTokWebhookAdmin");
function escapeHtml2(s) {
  return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" })[c]);
}

// src/routes/api.ts
async function handleApi(env2, req, url) {
  const path = url.pathname;
  const method = req.method.toUpperCase();
  if (path === "/api/status" && method === "GET") return statusResponse(env2);
  if (path === "/api/media" && method === "GET") return mediaResponse(env2);
  if (path === "/api/tiktok/status" && method === "GET") return json(await tikTokStatus(env2));
  if (path === "/api/tiktok/media" && method === "GET") return tiktokMediaResponse(env2);
  if (path === "/api/campaigns" && method === "GET") return campaignsList(env2, url);
  if (path === "/api/campaigns" && method === "POST") return campaignSave(env2, req);
  if (path === "/api/campaigns/status" && method === "POST") return campaignStatus(env2, req);
  if (path === "/api/campaigns/archive" && method === "POST") return campaignArchive(env2, req);
  if (path === "/api/campaigns/delete" && method === "POST") return campaignDelete(env2, req);
  if (path === "/api/dashboard" && method === "GET") return dashboard(env2, url);
  if (path === "/api/contacts" && method === "GET") return contacts(env2, url);
  if (path === "/api/contacts/export" && method === "GET") return contactsCsv(env2, url);
  return json({ error: "not found" }, 404);
}
__name(handleApi, "handleApi");
async function statusResponse(env2) {
  const auth = await getAuth(env2.DB);
  if (!auth) return json({ connected: false });
  return json({
    connected: true,
    username: auth.username,
    account_type: auth.account_type,
    profile_picture_url: auth.profile_picture_url,
    ig_user_id: auth.ig_user_id,
    expires_at: auth.expires_at,
    expires_in_days: Math.max(0, Math.round((auth.expires_at - now()) / 86400)),
    token_expired: auth.expires_at <= now()
  });
}
__name(statusResponse, "statusResponse");

        comments_count: v.comments,

      }))

async function dashboard(env2, url) {
  const campaignId = url.searchParams.get("campaign_id");
  const days = Math.max(1, Math.min(365, Number(url.searchParams.get("days")) || 30));
  const since = now() - days * 86400;
  const counts = await eventCountsByType(env2.DB, campaignId, since);
  const comments = counts.comment_matched;
  const pct = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((n) => comments > 0 ? Math.round(n / comments * 100) : 0, "pct");
  return json({
    campaign_id: campaignId,
    days,
    cards: {
      comments,
      sends: counts.opening_sent,
      clicks: counts.button_clicked,
      ctr: counts.opening_sent > 0 ? Math.round(counts.button_clicked / counts.opening_sent * 100) : 0,
      follows: counts.follow_confirmed,
      emails: counts.email_captured,
      delivered: counts.delivered
    },
    funnel: [
      { label: "Commented", value: comments, pct: 100 },
      { label: "Clicked", value: counts.button_clicked, pct: pct(counts.button_clicked) },
      { label: "Followed", value: counts.follow_confirmed, pct: pct(counts.follow_confirmed) },
      { label: "Gave email", value: counts.email_captured, pct: pct(counts.email_captured) },
      { label: "Delivered", value: counts.delivered, pct: pct(counts.delivered) }
    ]
  });
}

var STATE_LABEL = {
  NEW: "opening",
  AWAITING_TAP: "opening sent",
  AWAITING_FOLLOW: "awaiting follow",
  AWAITING_EMAIL: "awaiting email",
  DELIVER: "delivering",

async function contacts(env2, url) {

  return json({
    contacts: rows.map((r) => ({
      igsid: r.igsid,
      username: r.username,
      campaign_id: r.campaign_id,
      state: r.state,
      status_label: STATE_LABEL[r.state] ?? r.state,
      followed: r.followed === 1,
      email: r.email,
      updated_at: r.updated_at
    }))
  });
}

async function contactsCsv(env2, url) {
  const campaignId = url.searchParams.get("campaign_id");
  const rows = await listConversations(env2.DB, campaignId);
  const header = ["username", "igsid", "campaign_id", "status", "followed", "email", "updated_at"];
  const lines = [header.join(",")];
  for (const r of rows) {
    lines.push(
      [
        csv(r.username ?? ""),
        csv(r.igsid),
        csv(r.campaign_id),
        csv(STATE_LABEL[r.state] ?? r.state),
        r.followed === 1 ? "yes" : "no",
        csv(r.email ?? ""),
        new Date(r.updated_at * 1e3).toISOString()
      ].join(",")
    );
  }
  return new Response(lines.join("\n"), {
    headers: {
      "content-type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
      "content-disposition": `attachment; filename="chatmany-contacts.csv"`
    }
  });
}
__name(contactsCsv, "contactsCsv");
function csv(v) {
  return /[",\n]/.test(v) ? `"${v.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : v;
}

  }
}

// src/routes/tiktokWebhook.ts
var SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 300;
function handleTikTokWebhookVerify(url) {
  const challenge = url.searchParams.get("challenge");
  return new Response(challenge ?? "ok", { status: 200, headers: { "content-type": "text/plain" } });
}
__name(handleTikTokWebhookVerify, "handleTikTokWebhookVerify");
async function handleTikTokWebhookEvent(env2, req) {
  if (!env2.TIKTOK_APP_SECRET) return json({ error: "TIKTOK_APP_SECRET not configured" }, 503);
  const raw = await req.text();
  const sig = req.headers.get("tiktok-signature");
  if (!await verifyTikTokSignature(env2.TIKTOK_APP_SECRET, raw, sig, now())) {
    return new Response("invalid signature", { status: 401 });
  }
  let envelope;
  try {
    envelope = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return json({ error: "invalid JSON" }, 400);
  }
  if (env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID && envelope.client_key && envelope.client_key !== env2.TIKTOK_APP_ID) {
    return json({ ok: true, ignored: "other app" });
  }
  const normalized = normalizeTikTokEvent(envelope);
  if (normalized.kind === "ignored") return json({ ok: true, ignored: normalized.reason });
  const rt = await buildTikTokRuntime(env2);
  if (!rt) return json({ ok: true, note: "no TikTok account connected" });
  if (envelope.user_openid && envelope.user_openid !== rt.businessId) {
    return json({ ok: true, ignored: "other business account" });
  }
  try {
    if (normalized.kind === "comment") {
      let evt = normalized.event;
      if (!evt.text || !evt.igsid || !evt.username) {
        try {
          const [c] = await rt.client.getComments(evt.media_id, [evt.comment_id]);
          if (c) {
            evt = {
              ...evt,
              text: evt.text || c.text || "",
              igsid: evt.igsid || c.unique_identifier || c.user_id || "",
              username: evt.username ?? c.username
            };
            if (c.owner) return json({ ok: true, ignored: "own comment" });
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] comment read-back failed for ${evt.comment_id}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
        }
      }
      if (!evt.igsid) return json({ ok: true, ignored: "no commenter id" });
      await rt.engine.handleComment(evt);
    } else {
      await rt.engine.handleMessage(normalized.event);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`[chatmany:tiktok] webhook handling failed (${envelope.event}): ${e instanceof Error ? e.stack ?? e.message : e}`);
  }
  return json({ ok: true });
}
__name(handleTikTokWebhookEvent, "handleTikTokWebhookEvent");
function normalizeTikTokEvent(envelope) {
  const content = parseContent(envelope.content);
  switch (envelope.event) {
    case "comment.update": {
      if (content.comment_action !== "insert") return { kind: "ignored", reason: `comment ${String(content.comment_action)}` };
      if (content.comment_type && content.comment_type !== "comment") return { kind: "ignored", reason: "comment reply" };
      const commentId = idString(content.comment_id);
      const videoId = idString(content.video_id);
      if (!commentId || !videoId) return { kind: "ignored", reason: "comment without ids" };
      return {
        kind: "comment",
        event: {
          kind: "comment",
          comment_id: commentId,
          igsid: typeof content.unique_identifier === "string" ? content.unique_identifier : "",
          text: typeof content.text === "string" ? content.text : "",
          media_id: videoId,
          timestamp: toSeconds(content.timestamp, envelope.create_time)
        }
      };
    }
    case "im_receive_msg": {
      const from = content.from_user ?? {};
      if (from.role && from.role !== "personal_account") return { kind: "ignored", reason: `message from ${from.role}` };
      const igsid = from.id || (typeof content.unique_identifier === "string" ? content.unique_identifier : "");
      const conversationId = typeof content.conversation_id === "string" ? content.conversation_id : "";
      if (!igsid || !conversationId) return { kind: "ignored", reason: "message without sender/conversation" };
      const text = content.type === "text" ? content.text?.body : void 0;
      const payload = content.reply_source_payload?.reply_source_unique_id;
      return {
        kind: "message",
        event: {
          kind: "message",
          igsid,
          text,
          payload,
          timestamp: toSeconds(content.timestamp, envelope.create_time),
          conversation_id: conversationId,
          is_follower: typeof content.is_follower === "boolean" ? content.is_follower : void 0,
          username: typeof content.from === "string" ? content.from : void 0,
          message_id: typeof content.message_id === "string" ? content.message_id : void 0
        }
      };
    }
    case "im_receive_msg_eu":
      return { kind: "ignored", reason: "EU message (stripped payload)" };
    default:
      return { kind: "ignored", reason: envelope.event ?? "unknown event" };
  }
}
__name(normalizeTikTokEvent, "normalizeTikTokEvent");
function parseContent(content) {
  if (!content) return {};
  const safe = content.replace(/("(?:comment_id|video_id|parent_comment_id)"\s*:\s*)(\d{15,})/g, '$1"$2"');
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(safe);
    return typeof parsed === "object" && parsed !== null ? parsed : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}
__name(parseContent, "parseContent");
function idString(v) {
  if (typeof v === "string") return v;
  if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(v)) return String(v);
  return "";
}
__name(idString, "idString");
function toSeconds(contentTs, envelopeTs) {
  if (typeof contentTs === "number" && contentTs > 0) return contentTs > 1e12 ? Math.floor(contentTs / 1e3) : Math.floor(contentTs);
  if (typeof envelopeTs === "number" && envelopeTs > 0) return Math.floor(envelopeTs);
  return now();
}
__name(toSeconds, "toSeconds");
async function verifyTikTokSignature(appSecret, raw, header, nowSeconds, toleranceSeconds = SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS) {
  if (!header || !appSecret) return false;
  const parts = {};
  for (const kv of header.split(",")) {
    const i = kv.indexOf("=");
    if (i > 0) parts[kv.slice(0, i).trim()] = kv.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
  const t = Number(parts.t);
  const s = (parts.s ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (!Number.isFinite(t) || !s) return false;
  if (Math.abs(nowSeconds - t) > toleranceSeconds) return false;
  const expected = await hmacHex(appSecret, `${t}.${raw}`);
  if (expected.length !== s.length) return false;
  let mismatch = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) mismatch |= expected.charCodeAt(i) ^ s.charCodeAt(i);
  return mismatch === 0;
}
__name(verifyTikTokSignature, "verifyTikTokSignature");
async function hmacHex(secret, message) {
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", new TextEncoder().encode(secret), { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" }, false, ["sign"]);
  const mac = await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, new TextEncoder().encode(message));
  return [...new Uint8Array(mac)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}
__name(hmacHex, "hmacHex");

// src/poller/tiktokPoll.ts
var MSG_CURSOR_KEY = "tiktok_last_msg_poll_ts";
var OVERLAP_MS = 12e4;
var MAX_CONVERSATIONS_PER_TICK = 25;
async function pollTikTokComments(rt, db) {
  const campaigns = await getActiveCampaigns(db, "tiktok");
  if (campaigns.length === 0) return;
  const videoIds = [...new Set(campaigns.map((c) => c.media_id))];
  for (const videoId of videoIds) {
    let comments;
    try {
      comments = (await rt.client.listComments(videoId, 30)).comments;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] listComments(${videoId}) failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
      continue;
    }
    const handled = await processedCommentIds(db, comments.map((c) => c.comment_id));
    for (const c of comments) {
      if (handled.has(c.comment_id)) continue;
      if (c.owner || c.parent_comment_id) continue;
      const igsid = c.unique_identifier || c.user_id;
      if (!igsid) continue;
      const evt = {
        kind: "comment",
        comment_id: c.comment_id,
        igsid,
        username: c.username,
        text: c.text ?? "",
        media_id: videoId,
        timestamp: Number(c.create_time) || now()
      };
      await rt.engine.handleComment(evt, campaigns);
    }
  }
}
__name(pollTikTokComments, "pollTikTokComments");
async function pollTikTokMessages(rt, db) {
  const cursorRaw = await kvGet(db, MSG_CURSOR_KEY);
  const cursor = cursorRaw ? Number(cursorRaw) : 0;
  const floor = cursor > 0 ? cursor - OVERLAP_MS : 0;
  let conversations = [];
  for (const type of ["STRANGER", "SINGLE"]) {
    try {
      conversations.push(...await rt.client.listConversations(type));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] listConversations(${type}) failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
    }
  }
  conversations = conversations.filter((c) => (c.update_time ?? 0) >= floor).sort((a, b) => (b.update_time ?? 0) - (a.update_time ?? 0)).slice(0, MAX_CONVERSATIONS_PER_TICK);
  let maxTs = cursor;
  for (const convo of conversations) {
    let messages, participants;
    try {
      ({ messages, participants } = await rt.client.listMessages(convo.conversation_id));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`[chatmany:tiktok] listMessages failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
      continue;
    }
    const person = participants.find((p) => p.role === "PERSONAL_ACCOUNT");
    for (const m of messages) {
      const fromId = m.from_user?.id;
      if (!fromId || fromId === rt.businessId || m.from_user?.role === "BUSINESS_ACCOUNT") continue;
      const ts = m.timestamp ?? 0;
      if (ts < floor) continue;
      if (ts > maxTs) maxTs = ts;
      const evt = {
        kind: "message",
        igsid: fromId,
        text: m.message_type === "TEXT" ? m.text?.body : void 0,
        timestamp: Math.floor(ts / 1e3),
        conversation_id: convo.conversation_id,
        is_follower: person?.is_follower,
        username: person?.display_name,
        message_id: m.message_id
      };
      await rt.engine.handleMessage(evt);
    }
  }
  await kvSet(db, MSG_CURSOR_KEY, String(Math.max(maxTs, Date.now() - OVERLAP_MS)));
}
__name(pollTikTokMessages, "pollTikTokMessages");

// src/index.ts
var POLL_CRON = "* * * * *";
var REFRESH_CRON = "0 3 * * *";
var index_default = {
  async fetch(req, env2) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const { pathname } = url;
    const method = req.method.toUpperCase();
    if (pathname === "/health") return json({ ok: true, mode: env2.MODE });
    if (pathname === "/auth/authorize" && method === "GET") return handleAuthorize(env2);
    if (pathname === "/auth/callback" && method === "GET") return handleCallback(env2, url);
    if (pathname === "/webhook" && method === "GET") return handleWebhookVerify(env2, url);
    if (pathname === "/webhook" && method === "POST") return handleWebhookEvent(env2, req);
    if (pathname === "/auth/tiktok/authorize" && method === "GET") return handleTikTokAuthorize(env2, url);
    if (pathname === "/auth/tiktok/callback" && method === "GET") return handleTikTokCallback(env2, url);
    if (pathname === "/webhook/tiktok" && method === "GET") return handleTikTokWebhookVerify(url);
    if (pathname === "/webhook/tiktok" && method === "POST") return handleTikTokWebhookEvent(env2, req);
    if (pathname.startsWith("/api/")) {
      if (!isOwner(req, url, env2)) return json({ error: "unauthorized" }, 401);
      return handleApi(env2, req, url);
    }
    const ownerRoutes = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
      "/auth/status",
      "/auth/disconnect",
      "/config/import",
      "/config/export",
      "/admin/poll",
      "/auth/tiktok/status",
      "/auth/tiktok/disconnect",
      "/admin/tiktok/webhooks",
      "/admin/tiktok/poll"
    ]);
    if (ownerRoutes.has(pathname)) {
      if (!isOwner(req, url, env2)) return json({ error: "unauthorized" }, 401);
      if (pathname === "/auth/status" && method === "GET") return handleStatus(env2);
      if (pathname === "/auth/disconnect" && method === "POST") return handleDisconnect(env2);
      if (pathname === "/config/import" && method === "POST") return handleConfigImport(env2, req);
      if (pathname === "/config/export" && method === "GET") return handleConfigExport(env2);
      if (pathname === "/admin/poll" && method === "POST") {
        await runPoll(env2);
        return json({ ok: true, ran: "poll" });
      }
      if (pathname === "/auth/tiktok/status" && method === "GET") return handleTikTokStatus(env2);
      if (pathname === "/auth/tiktok/disconnect" && method === "POST") return handleTikTokDisconnect(env2);
      if (pathname === "/admin/tiktok/webhooks") return handleTikTokWebhookAdmin(env2, req, url);
      if (pathname === "/admin/tiktok/poll" && method === "POST") {
        const ran = await runTikTokPoll(env2);
        return json({ ok: true, ran: ran ? "tiktok-poll" : "skipped (no TikTok account connected)" });
      }
      return json({ error: "method not allowed" }, 405);
    }
    const assetRes = await env2.ASSETS.fetch(req);
    if (assetRes.status !== 404) return assetRes;
    if (method === "GET") {
      return env2.ASSETS.fetch(new Request(new URL("/index.html", url.origin), req));
    }
    return json({ error: "not found" }, 404);
  },
  async scheduled(event, env2) {
    if (event.cron === REFRESH_CRON) {
      const result = await refreshTokenIfDue(env2);
      console.log(`[chatmany] token refresh: ${result.status}`);
      return;
    }
    if (event.cron === POLL_CRON) {
      const tt = await refreshTikTokTokenIfDue(env2);
      if (tt.status === "refreshed" || tt.status === "error" || tt.status === "expired") {
        console.log(`[chatmany:tiktok] token refresh: ${tt.status}${tt.detail ? ` (${tt.detail})` : ""}`);
      }
      if (env2.TIKTOK_MODE === "polling") await runTikTokPoll(env2);
      if (env2.MODE === "webhook") return;
      await runPoll(env2);
    }
  }
};
async function runTikTokPoll(env2) {
  const rt = await buildTikTokRuntime(env2);
  if (!rt) return false;
  await pollTikTokComments(rt, env2.DB);
  await pollTikTokMessages(rt, env2.DB);
  return true;
}
__name(runTikTokPoll, "runTikTokPoll");
async function runPoll(env2) {
  const interval = Math.max(30, Number(env2.POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS) || 90);
  const claimed = await claimPollSlot(env2.DB, interval);
  if (!claimed) return;
  if (!await acquireRunLock(env2.DB)) {
    console.warn("[chatmany] previous poll still running; skipping this tick.");
    return;
  }
  try {
    const rt = await buildRuntime(env2);
    if (!rt) return;
    await pollMessages(rt, env2.DB);
    await pollComments(rt, env2.DB);
  } finally {
    await releaseRunLock(env2.DB);
  }
}
__name(runPoll, "runPoll");
var RUN_LOCK_SECONDS = 900;
async function acquireRunLock(db) {
  const ts = now();
  await db.prepare("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('poll_lock_until', '0', ?)").bind(ts).run();
  const res = await db.prepare("UPDATE kv SET value = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE key = 'poll_lock_until' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER) <= ?").bind(String(ts + RUN_LOCK_SECONDS), ts, ts).run();
  return (res.meta?.changes ?? 0) > 0;
}
async function releaseRunLock(db) {
  await db.prepare("UPDATE kv SET value = '0', updated_at = ? WHERE key = 'poll_lock_until'").bind(now()).run();
}
export {
  index_default as default
};
